versions.headline: Sunderland 缺陣嚴重，Aston Villa 小幅看好，但 Villa 主場表現平平
reasons: Sunderland 缺陣影響指數 2.49，Xhaka 和 Brobbey 都不能上場，中場和鋒線都被削弱。
Aston Villa 本季主場只有 1 勝，3 天後還有歐冠，勝率維持在市場水平，不再加碼。
裁判 Madley 場均 4.8 張黃牌，Sunderland 預計控球較少、犯規較多，黃牌數偏高。
versions.headline_en: Sunderland are badly depleted, so Aston Villa are slight favourites, though Villa's home form has been average
reasons_en: Sunderland's absence index is 2.49: Xhaka and Brobbey are both out, which weakens their midfield and attack.
Villa have only one home win this season and play in the UCL 3 days later, so we kept them at the market price rather than adding more.
Madley averages 4.8 yellows a game; Sunderland should have less of the ball and commit more fouls, so the card count leans high.

versions.headline: Bournemouth 四連勝，主場小幅看好，Nott'm Forest 兩名中場主力成疑
reasons: Bournemouth 最近聯賽四連勝，主場 xG 2.04 比 0.95，表現穩定；市場賠率也在向他們傾斜。
Nott'm Forest 的 Schlager、N. Williams 都成疑，但模型看不到個別球員的影響，所以只小幅調整。
進球線偏低（大 2.5 球 47%），比分以 1-0、1-1 為主。
versions.headline_en: Bournemouth have won four in a row and are slight home favourites; two Forest regulars are doubtful
reasons_en: Bournemouth have won their last four league games and have a solid home xG of 2.04 vs 0.95; the odds are also moving their way.
Forest's Schlager and N. Williams are doubtful, but the model cannot see individual players, so we made only a small adjustment.
The goals line is low (47% over 2.5), so 1-0 and 1-1 are the most likely scores.

versions.headline: 兩隊實力接近，Brentford 主場稍佔優勢，但 Thiago 停賽，平局機會大
reasons: Brentford 主場 3 勝 1 平 1 負，xG 1.81 比 1.12，但主力前鋒 Thiago 因紅牌停賽。
主勝賠率從 2.0 升到 2.15，市場在向 Everton 傾斜；兩隊實力接近，平局給 29%。
Everton 上半場很少進球（場均 0.2 球），最可能的半場比分是 0-0。
versions.headline_en: An even match with a slight home edge for Brentford, but Thiago is suspended and a draw is very possible
reasons_en: Brentford are W3 D1 L1 at home with xG 1.81 vs 1.12, but top striker Thiago is suspended after a red card.
Brentford's price has drifted from 2.0 to 2.15 and the market is moving towards Everton; with the teams this close, the draw is set at 29%.
Everton rarely score before half-time (0.2 a game), so 0-0 is the most likely half-time score.

versions.headline: 兩隊實力接近，Thiago 停賽加上賠率持續向 Everton 傾斜，平局可能性不低。
reasons: Brentford 主場 3 勝 1 平 1 負，xG 1.81 比 1.12，但主力前鋒 Thiago 因紅牌停賽。
主勝賠率從開盤 2.0 一路升到 2.3，客勝從 3.5 降到 3.0，市場持續看好 Everton。
Everton 上半場很少進球（場均 0.2 球），最可能的半場比分是 0-0；兩隊實力接近，平局保留 29%。
versions.key_changes: 主勝賠率由 2.15 再升到 2.3，從主勝移 2 點到客勝（42/29/29 → 40/29/31）；全場犯規按低估偏差略上調。
versions.headline_en: Evenly matched; with Thiago suspended and the odds drifting towards Everton, a draw is very much in play.
reasons_en: Brentford are 3W 1D 1L at home (xG 1.81 vs 1.12), but top striker Thiago is suspended (red card).
The home price has drifted from 2.0 to 2.3 and the away price shortened from 3.5 to 3.0 — steady market support for Everton.
Everton rarely score before the break (0.2 per game), so 0-0 at half-time is most likely; with the sides close, the draw stays at 29%.
versions.key_changes_en: Home odds drifted further from 2.15 to 2.3, so 2 points moved from home win to away win (42/29/29 → 40/29/31); full-time fouls nudged up to correct the underestimation bias.

versions.headline: Chelsea 缺幾名主力，賠率在走弱，平局機會不低
reasons: Chelsea 缺 J. Pedro（5 球 3 助攻）和 Lacroix，主勝賠率從 1.8 升到 1.95，市場在降低對他們的信心。
Leeds 10 場只失 8 球，防守紮實；兩隊預期進球不多，按守則平局至少給 28%。
Leeds 預計控球較少，犯規和黃牌偏向客隊。
versions.headline_en: Chelsea are missing key players and drifting in the market; a draw is a real chance
reasons_en: Chelsea are without J. Pedro (5 goals, 3 assists) and Lacroix, and their win price has drifted from 1.8 to 1.95.
Leeds have conceded only 8 in 10; with a modest goal expectancy, our rules keep the draw at 28% or higher.
Leeds should have less of the ball, so fouls and cards lean towards the away side.

versions.headline: 兩支降級區球隊對決，形勢接近，Coventry 主場稍佔上風
reasons: Crystal Palace 近五場輸了四場，10 場失 24 球，作客場均只有 0.8 分。
賠率卻在向 Palace 傾斜，Elo 也看好他們；純本季數據模型則看好 Coventry，所以取中間，主勝略高。
兩隊後防都不穩，雙方進球機率接近六成。
versions.headline_en: A clash between two relegation-zone sides; it is close, with Coventry slightly ahead at home
reasons_en: Crystal Palace have lost four of their last five, conceded 24 in 10, and take only 0.8 points a game away.
The odds are moving towards Palace and Elo favours them, while the season-only model favours Coventry; we sit in between with a slight home edge.
Both defences are shaky, so both teams scoring is close to 60%.

versions.headline: 兩支護級球隊勢均力敵，賠率繼續向 Crystal Palace 傾斜
reasons: Coventry 主力後衛 Yirenkyi（首發 8 場）沒有進入首發名單，後防再少一人。
賠率由開盤主 2.25／客 3.0 變成 2.6／2.7，市場明顯轉向 Crystal Palace。
Crystal Palace 近五場輸了四場，10 場失 24 球；Mateta 停賽，由 Larsen 首發中鋒。
兩隊後防都不穩，雙方進球機率約 55%，平局保持 28%。
versions.key_changes: Yirenkyi 確定不首發，加上賠率繼續轉向客隊，主勝由 40% 降到 38%，客勝由 32% 升到 34%。
versions.headline_en: Evenly matched relegation battle; odds keep moving toward Crystal Palace
reasons_en: Coventry's regular defender Yirenkyi (8 starts) is not in the XI, leaving their back line another starter short.
Odds have moved from 2.25/3.0 at opening to 2.6/2.7, a clear market swing toward Crystal Palace.
Crystal Palace have lost four of their last five and conceded 24 in 10 games; Mateta is suspended, so Larsen leads the line.
Both defences are shaky, so BTTS is about 55%, and the draw stays at 28%.
versions.key_changes_en: Yirenkyi confirmed out of the XI and the odds kept moving toward the visitors: home win 40%→38%, away win 32%→34%.

versions.headline: Brighton 實力明顯較強，但 Hull City 主場還沒輸過，客勝不宜過高
reasons: Brighton 10 場進 26 球，排第 2 位，市場給客勝約 63%。
Hull City 主場 1 勝 4 平未嘗敗績，打五後衛防守；按守則，客勝要低於市場，主勝和平局要上調。
Hull City 控球較少，場均 3 張黃牌，裁判 Bankes 場均 5 張，主隊犯規和黃牌較多。
versions.headline_en: Brighton are clearly stronger, but Hull City are unbeaten at home, so the away win should not be priced too high
reasons_en: Brighton have scored 26 in 10 and sit 2nd; the market gives them about 63%.
Hull are unbeaten at home (W1 D4) and play a back five; under our rules we trim the away win below the market and raise the home win and the draw.
Hull will have less of the ball and average 3 yellows a game, and Bankes averages 5, so expect more fouls and cards from the home side.

versions.headline: Brighton 主力齊出，仍看好客勝；Hull City 主場難輸，但進攻偏弱
reasons: Brighton 首發接近最強陣容（Verbruggen、Dunk、Groß、Rutter），只缺長期傷停的 Mitoma 和 Tzimas；4 天後的歐協聯也沒有令他們輪換。
市場客勝賠率由 1.55 降到 1.5，去水後客勝約 63%；Hull City 主場 1 勝 4 平未輸，按守則客勝定在市場以下，主勝定得比市場高。
Hull City 今場排 4-5-1，不是五後衛，中場人多但控球偏少，預料 Brighton 控球壓制、角球較多。
Hull City 場均犯規 11.4 次、黃牌 3 張，加上過往犯規常被低估，主隊犯規和黃牌上調；裁判 Bankes 的數據只作小幅參考。
versions.key_changes: 首發已確認：Brighton 主力齊出，而且賠率繼續傾向客隊，客勝由 57% 上調到 59%，主勝由 19% 降到 17%。Hull City 實際排 4-5-1，所以修正了「五後衛」的說法。全場犯規略為上調（主隊 12），以校正過往低估的偏差；Brighton 壓制時角球通常較多，角球改為 4.0 比 6.2。
versions.headline_en: Brighton field a near-full XI and remain favourites; Hull City are hard to beat at home but blunt in attack
reasons_en: Brighton start close to their best XI (Verbruggen, Dunk, Groß, Rutter), missing only long-term absentees Mitoma and Tzimas; the Conference League game in 4 days has not caused rotation.
The away price shortened from 1.55 to 1.5 (de-vigged ~63%); Hull City are unbeaten at home (W1 D4), so per the playbook the away win sits below market and the home win above market.
Hull City line up 4-5-1, not a back five: a crowded midfield but little possession, so expect Brighton to control the ball and win more corners.
Hull City average 11.4 fouls and 3 yellows per game, and fouls have been underestimated before, so home fouls and cards are nudged up; referee Bankes's averages are only a small adjustment.
versions.key_changes_en: Line-ups confirmed: Brighton are at full strength and the odds keep moving their way, so the away win goes from 57% to 59% and the home win from 19% to 17%. Hull City actually play 4-5-1, so the 'back five' claim is corrected. Full-time fouls are raised slightly (home 12) to correct the past underestimation, and corners are now 4.0 vs 6.2 because Brighton usually win more corners when they dominate.

versions.headline: Liverpool 主場看好，但他們主場表現差，而且 van Dijk 成疑
reasons: Man United 10 場失 19 球，排第 18 位，市場給 Liverpool 勝率上升到約 57%。
Liverpool 本季主場只有 1 勝，van Dijk 成疑，兩隊 3 天後都要踢歐冠，所以略低於市場。
這是同城宿敵之戰，雙方後防都不穩，大球和雙方進球機率都接近六成。
versions.headline_en: Liverpool are home favourites, but their home form is poor and van Dijk is doubtful
reasons_en: Man United have conceded 19 in 10 and sit 18th; the market has moved Liverpool up to about 57%.
Liverpool have only one home win, van Dijk is doubtful and both teams play in the UCL 3 days later, so we sit slightly below the market.
It is a derby with two shaky defences, so over 2.5 and both teams scoring are both close to 60%.

versions.headline: van Dijk 確定首發，Liverpool 稍佔優勢，但 Man United 進球能力不弱，2-1 主勝可能性最大
reasons: 正式首發已公佈：上一版成疑的 van Dijk 確定首發，Liverpool 後防比預期穩；Gakpo 和 Ekitiké 缺陣早已計入。
賠率小幅偏向主隊（主勝 1.8→1.75），去水後約 54/23/23，統計基準 55/22/24，主勝只上調約 1.5 個百分點，符合不大幅加碼熱門的守則。
Man United 失球多（10 場失 19 球），但近況進球能力不差，Mbeumo、Cunha、Fernandes 都首發；Liverpool 本季主場只有 1 勝，所以大球和雙方進球仍接近六成。
兩隊休息了兩週，3 天後都要踢歐冠，這是同城宿敵之戰；裁判 Barrott 場均犯規偏少，黃牌按守則只微調，全場犯規比基準稍高，以修正過去低估的偏差。
versions.key_changes: 首發確認 van Dijk 出場，主勝由 54% 升至 55.5%，客勝由 23% 降至 21.5%；總進球由約 3.3 略降至 3.0（Liverpool 主場進攻效率偏低），犯規按過往低估的偏差上調。
versions.headline_en: With van Dijk confirmed in the XI, Liverpool hold a slight edge, but United can score; 2-1 home win is the most likely outcome
reasons_en: Confirmed line-ups: van Dijk, doubtful in the last version, starts, so Liverpool's defence looks steadier; Gakpo and Ekitiké's absences were already priced in.
Odds have drifted slightly toward the home side (1.8→1.75); de-vigged ~54/23/23 and baseline 55/22/24, so home win is nudged up only ~1.5 pts, in line with the no-overboosting rule.
United concede a lot (19 in 10) but keep scoring, with Mbeumo, Cunha and Fernandes all starting; Liverpool have just one home win this season, so Over 2.5 and BTTS stay near 60%.

Both sides had two weeks off and play the Champions League in 3 days; it's a derby, and referee Barrott's foul average is low, so cards get only a small tweak while total fouls sit slightly above baseline to correct past underestimation.
versions.key_changes_en: van Dijk confirmed starting: home win 54%→55.5%, away 23%→21.5%; total goals trimmed from ~3.3 to 3.0 (Liverpool's weak home attack); fouls raised to correct the known underestimation bias.

versions.headline: Man City 主場仍是熱門，但連敗三場加上週中有歐冠，勝率比市場低一點
reasons: 市場與基準都給 Man City 約 68% 勝率，但他們近三場聯賽全敗，純本季數據模型只給 57%，因此下調到 62%。
Semenyo 缺陣、Guéhi 成疑，3 天後要踢歐冠對 Napoli，可能會輪換。
Fulham 客場場均只進 0.6 球，但雙方進球機率仍有近六成；預期 Man City 控球壓制，角球大幅領先。
裁判 Bramall 場均只出 2.2 張黃牌，黃牌總數預計偏少。
versions.headline_en: Man City remain home favourites, but three straight league defeats and a midweek UCL game keep them slightly below the market price
reasons_en: The market and baseline give City about 68%, but they have lost three league games in a row and the season-only model gives just 57%, so we lowered it to 62%.
Semenyo is out, Guéhi is doubtful, and the UCL game against Napoli is 3 days later, so City may rotate.
Fulham score only 0.6 a game away, but both teams scoring is still close to 60%; City should dominate the ball and win the corner count clearly.
Referee Bramall averages only 2.2 yellows a game, so expect a low card count.

versions.headline: Man City 派出最強陣容，主勝機率上調至 65%，但近況差，仍不及市場看好的程度
reasons: 首發已確認：Haaland、Foden、Doku 都首發，Guéhi 也傷癒回到後防，Man City 沒有因為 3 天後要踢歐冠對 Napoli 而輪換。
賠率持續向主隊傾斜（1.42→1.36），去水後主勝約 70%；但 Man City 聯賽三連敗，只用本季數據的模型只給 57%，所以停在兩者之間。
Fulham 客場場均只進 0.6 球，Muniz 單前鋒進攻威脅有限，比分前三選項都包括 Man City 零封或只丟一球的結果。
預期 Man City 控球壓制，角球大幅領先；裁判 Bramall 出牌偏少，黃牌總數預計約 3.4 張，多數會是 Fulham 球員防守犯規。
versions.key_changes: 上一版擔心 Man City 輪換、Guéhi 成疑；現在首發確認是主力全部上場，主勝由 62% 上調到 65%，平局 20→19，客勝 18→16；比分選項把 1-1 換成 1-0；新增犯規預測（上半場已按守則下調）。
versions.headline_en: Man City field their strongest XI; home win nudged up to 65%, still below the market given their poor form
reasons_en: Confirmed XI: Haaland, Foden and Doku all start and Guéhi returns in defence, so City have not rotated ahead of the Champions League game against Napoli in 3 days.

The odds keep moving toward the home side (1.42→1.36), about 70% after removing the bookmaker margin, but City have lost three league games in a row and the season-only model gives 57%, so we sit between the two.
Fulham score only 0.6 goals per away game and Muniz alone up front offers little threat; every score in our top three has City keeping a clean sheet or conceding once.
Expect City to dominate the ball and win far more corners; referee Bramall gives few cards, so about 3.4 yellows in total, most of them to Fulham for defensive fouls.
versions.key_changes_en: Last version expected City to rotate and listed Guéhi as doubtful. The confirmed XI is full strength, so home win goes up 62→65%, draw 20→19, away 18→16. In the scorelines, 1-0 replaces 1-1. Added foul predictions, with first-half fouls lowered per the playbook.

versions.headline: Arsenal 作客看好，但 Saka 缺陣、週中有歐冠，可能又是一場低比分小勝
reasons: Arsenal 10 場只失 5 球，作客 4 勝 1 負，但進球不多，常以 1-0 取勝。
Saka 和 Zubimendi 缺陣，3 天後還有歐冠對 Dortmund；按守則，客隊控球型熱門的勝率不高於市場。
Newcastle 主場只有 1 勝，裁判 Kavanagh 場均 5 張黃牌，主隊黃牌預計較多。
versions.headline_en: Arsenal are away favourites, but with Saka out and a UCL game midweek, this could be another narrow, low-scoring win
reasons_en: Arsenal have conceded only 5 in 10 and won 4 of 5 away, but they do not score many and often win 1-0.
Saka and Zubimendi are out, and Dortmund come 3 days later; under our rules a possession-based away favourite stays at or below the market price.
Newcastle have one home win, and Kavanagh averages 5 yellows a game, so expect more cards for the home side.

versions.headline: Tottenham 主場看好，預計會壓制 Ipswich，角球大幅領先
reasons: Ipswich 作客場均失 2.6 球；Tottenham 主場場均 9.6 個角球，預計會一面倒壓制。
Tottenham 進攻效率不高（場均 1 球，上半場只有 0.2 球），所以大球和雙方進球機率略低於市場。
Tel 缺陣，但 Simons、Odobert 是長期傷患，球隊已經適應。
versions.headline_en: Tottenham are home favourites and should pin Ipswich back, with a big lead in corners
reasons_en: Ipswich concede 2.6 a game away; Spurs average 9.6 corners at home and should dominate.
Spurs are not clinical (1 goal a game, only 0.2 before half-time), so over 2.5 and both teams scoring sit slightly below the market.
Tel is out, but Simons and Odobert are long-term injuries the team has already adapted to.

versions.headline: Arsenal 主場全勝，略佔上風，但強強對決平局機會高
reasons: Arsenal 主場 5戰全勝，只失 0.4 球；Man City 近 5 場 1平3負。
基準和賽季模型都約 50%，強強對決再移 3 點到平局。
Raya 肩傷成疑，若換門將對主隊不利。
緊湊的強強對決犯規和黃牌偏多；Brooks 本季場均 5.6 張黃牌。
versions.headline_en: Perfect-at-home Arsenal edge it, but a big-game draw is very possible
reasons_en: Arsenal 5/5 wins at home, conceding 0.4; City D1 L3 in their last 5.
Baseline and model both ~50%; shifted 3 points to the draw for a tight top clash.
Raya doubtful (shoulder); a keeper change would hurt Arsenal.
Tight big-team games bring more fouls/cards; Brooks averages 5.6 yellows.

versions.headline: Brighton 主場 5場只失 1 球，看好主勝
reasons: Brighton 主場 4勝1平，場均進 3.0 球、失 0.2 球，xG 2.29 對 1.18，優勢明顯。
2.8 天前剛踢歐協聯，可能輪換，所以勝率比中間值低約 5 點。
Newcastle 作客 xG 只有 1.06，主隊壓制時角球應較多。
versions.headline_en: Brighton, one goal conceded in 5 home games, favoured
reasons_en: Brighton W4 D1 at home, scoring 3.0 and conceding 0.2, xG 2.29 vs 1.18.
UECL 2.8 days ago may bring rotation, so ~5 points below the model/baseline midpoint.
Newcastle's away xG is only 1.06; home dominance should mean more corners.

versions.headline: Crystal Palace 五連敗又缺 Mateta、Pino，主勝不穩
reasons: 市場看好主隊，但賽季模型反而略看好 Hull City，取中間值。
Palace 2.8 天前剛踢歐聯，Pino、Mateta 停賽，場均失 2.5 球。
Hull City 作客進攻弱（場均 0.8 球），平局拉高到 27%。
Gillett 場均 5.3 張黃牌，Hull City 本季場均 2.9 張，客隊黃牌偏多。
versions.headline_en: Five-straight-loss Palace without Mateta and Pino — shaky home favourites
reasons_en: Market backs Palace but the season model slightly prefers Hull; took the midpoint.
Palace played UEL 2.8 days ago, Pino and Mateta suspended, conceding 2.5 per game.
Hull weak in attack away (0.8 per game), so draw raised to 27%.
Gillett averages 5.3 yellows and Hull average 2.9, so more away cards.

versions.headline: Liverpool 作客強勢，Everton 缺 Tarkowski，但德比平局機會不小
reasons: Liverpool 作客 4勝1平0負，市場大幅轉向客隊，Everton 主力中後衛 Tarkowski 停賽。
賽季模型只給客勝 40.5%，Liverpool 3.7 天前踢歐冠，而且缺 Gakpo，所以低於市場。
Everton 主場 3勝1平1負；德比強度高，平局保留 26%。
德比氣氛下 Everton 犯規比基準多，Liverpool 角球佔優。
versions.headline_en: Liverpool favoured at Everton without Tarkowski, but derby draw risk is real
reasons_en: Liverpool W4 D1 L0 away; market swung hard their way with Everton's Tarkowski suspended.
Season model only 40.5% away; UCL 3.7 days ago and Gakpo out, so below market.
Everton W3 D1 L1 at home; derby intensity keeps draw at 26%.
Derby lifts Everton's fouls above baseline; Liverpool expected to win the corner count.

16363654.verdict: 主勝方向沒錯但結果是 0-0；控球和射門都由 Aston Villa 主導，只是把握機會太差。
points: Aston Villa 控球 72%、射門 19 次，但 xG 只有 0.98，壓制沒有變成進球，平局的機率給得太低（24%）。
角球預測 Aston Villa 4.6 個、實際 7 個，Sunderland 預測 4.1 個、實際只有 2 個：一方明顯壓制時，弱隊的角球被高估。
Sunderland 犯規 20 次，比預測的 13.2 次多很多；黃牌預測 1.8/2.6，實際 2/2，總數 4 張接近預期。
半場比分 0-0 預測正確；Aston Villa 3 天後要踢歐冠，可能刻意保留體力，這是進攻效率低的原因之一。
16363654.lesson: 主隊進攻效率低又有歐冠分心時，就算預期一面倒也要調高平局機率，角球要更偏向強勢一方。
16363654.verdict_en: Right direction but finished 0-0; Villa dominated possession and shots yet were wasteful in front of goal.
points_en: Villa had 72% possession and 19 shots but only 0.98 xG; the draw (24%) was underpriced.
Corners: Villa 7 vs 4.6 predicted, Sunderland 2 vs 4.1 — the weaker side's corners were overestimated in a one-sided game.
Sunderland committed 20 fouls vs 13.2 predicted; cards 2/2 vs 1.8/2.6, total close to expectation.
HT 0-0 was correct; with a Champions League game 3 days later, Villa may have managed effort, which helps explain the poor finishing.
16363654.lesson_en: When a low-efficiency home side has a UCL game days later, raise the draw probability even if dominance is expected, and skew corners further toward the dominant team.

16363655.verdict: 主勝預測正確，但上半場就 2-0，比賽比預期開放得多。
points: Bournemouth 51% 的勝率方向正確，但預測的進球數偏低：雙方合計 xG 5.02，遠超「小球」的判斷。
Nott'm Forest 射門 19 次、xG 2.15，卻只有 1 次射正，終結能力極差，這是零封的主要原因，模型無法預見。
上半場角球 4/1，比預測的 2.7/1.8 更偏向主隊；全場角球 6/4 和預測的 5/4 很接近。
黃牌 1/3 大致符合「客隊黃牌較多」的判斷；Nott'm Forest 落後追分，下半場犯規和黃牌增加。
16363655.lesson: 兩隊都有不錯的 xG 產出時，不要因為市場大 2.5 球只有 47% 就把比分壓在 1-0、1-1，比分選項要包含 2-0、2-1 這類較多進球的結果。
16363655.verdict_en: Home win called correctly, but it was 2-0 by half-time and far more open than expected.
points_en: The 51% home win was right, but goals were underestimated: combined xG 5.02 contradicted the low-scoring call.
Forest had 19 shots and 2.15 xG but only 1 on target — poor finishing explains the clean sheet, which the model cannot foresee.
1H corners 4/1 skewed more to the home side than 2.7/1.8; FT corners 6/4 were close to the 5/4 forecast.
Cards 1/3 matched the away-heavy call; Forest chasing the game raised second-half fouls and bookings.
16363655.lesson_en: When both sides generate good xG, don't anchor scorelines on 1-0/1-1 just because the over-2.5 market is 47%; include higher-scoring outcomes.

16363656.verdict: 賽前預測錯了：主勝只給 40%，半場判 0-0，實際 Brentford 4-0 大勝。主因是 23–25 分鐘連進兩球，加上 Tarkowski 40 分鐘被罰下，比賽提前失去懸念。
points: 勝平負方向勉強算對（主勝 40% 是三項中最高），但比分預測 1-1、1-0、2-1 和半場 0-0 都錯；半場 2-0 後更新為 3-0，接近終場比分。
偏差最大的是犯規：預測 12.5 比 10.0，實際只有 8 比 9。Brentford 領先又多一人，控球 72%，比賽節奏慢，雙方犯規都少。
Everton 黃牌預測 1.9，實際只有 1 張黃牌加 1 張紅牌；Brentford 預測 2.1 張，實際 0 張。少一人的一方被壓著打，衝突反而少。
市場一直看好 Everton（主勝賠率從 2.0 升到 2.3），模型也跟著壓低主勝，但 Thiago 停賽沒有削弱 Brentford 主場的進攻；xG 2.77 比 0.23 顯示兩隊實力差距被低估了。
16363656.lesson: Brentford 主場數據明顯較好，市場卻反向移動時，不要完全跟隨賠率壓低主隊；另外要記住，早段進球加紅牌之後，犯規和黃牌通常會比預測少。
16363656.verdict_en: The pre-match call was wrong: we gave the home win only 40% and predicted 0-0 at half-time, but Brentford won 4-0. Two goals in 23–25 minutes and Tarkowski's red card on 40' killed the game early.
points_en: The 1X2 lean was only marginally right (home win at 40% was the highest of the three), but the scorelines 1-1, 1-0, 2-1 and the 0-0 half-time call all missed; the half-time update to 3-0 came close to the final score.
Fouls were the biggest miss: we predicted 12.5 vs 10.0, the actual was 8 vs 9. Brentford led with an extra man and 72% possession, so the game was slow and both sides fouled little.
We predicted 1.9 yellows for Everton; they got 1 yellow plus 1 red. Brentford got 0 against 2.1 predicted. A side pinned back with ten men tends to have fewer clashes, not more.

The market kept backing Everton (home odds drifted from 2.0 to 2.3) and the model followed, but Thiago's suspension did not blunt Brentford at home; xG of 2.77 vs 0.23 shows the gap between the teams was underestimated.
16363656.lesson_en: When Brentford's home numbers are clearly stronger but the market drifts against them, don't follow the odds blindly and mark the home side down. Also, once an early goal is followed by a red card, fouls and yellow cards usually come in below the prediction.

16363657.verdict: 嚴重失誤：預測 Chelsea 小勝或平局，結果 Leeds 客場 4-1 大勝。
points: Leeds xG 2.52 對 0.56，全面壓制；缺少 J. Pedro 的 Chelsea 進攻比賠率反映的還弱，市場的變化（主勝 1.8→1.95）其實是警號。
53' 的點球讓 Leeds 反超，之後 Chelsea 壓上，Leeds 打反擊連進兩球，比賽態勢模型看不到。
「Leeds 防守紮實所以進球少」的判斷錯了：Leeds 防守好，不代表他們不能打出高效率的進攻。
犯規 6/15 符合「客隊犯規較多」的方向，但 Chelsea 只犯規 6 次、角球只有 3/2，都遠低於預測。
16363657.lesson: 主隊缺少核心進攻球員、賠率又持續走弱時，要果斷降低主勝機率，不能只停在市場水平。
16363657.verdict_en: Big miss: predicted a narrow Chelsea win or draw, Leeds won 4-1 away.
points_en: Leeds dominated with 2.52 xG vs 0.56; without J. Pedro, Chelsea's attack was weaker than the odds implied, and the drift (1.8→1.95) was a warning sign.
The 53' penalty put Leeds ahead; Chelsea then pushed forward and Leeds scored twice more on the counter — game-state effects the model can't see.
'Solid Leeds defence = low scoring' was wrong: a good defence does not mean an ineffective attack.
Fouls 6/15 matched the away-heavy direction, but Chelsea's 6 fouls and corners of 3/2 were far below forecast.
16363657.lesson_en: When the home side is missing its key attacker and the odds keep drifting, cut the home win probability decisively instead of staying at market level.

16363658.verdict: 方向偏差不大但比分完全錯：兩隊後防不穩的判斷正確，進球數卻嚴重低估。
points: 38/28/34 的預測接近五五開，Coventry 贏了算合理；但比分 1-1、1-0 太保守，實際打出 3-2。
上半場就 2-2，雙方合計 xG 3.87；賽前已經知道 Crystal Palace 10 場失 24 球、Coventry 主力後衛缺陣，進球線應該調高。
制勝球是 85' 的 McNeil 烏龍球，屬於隨機事件，不必過度解讀。
角球 4/6 和預測的 5/3.8 相反，控球較多的 Crystal Palace 角球也較多；黃牌 1/2 稍低於預測。
16363658.lesson: 兩隊後防都很差、又有主力後衛缺陣時，要明顯調高大球和雙方進球的機率，比分預測要包含 2-2、3-2。
16363658.verdict_en: Outcome split was reasonable but the scoreline was way off: shaky defences called right, goals badly underestimated.
points_en: 38/28/34 was near a coin flip, so a Coventry win is defensible; but 1-1/1-0 was too conservative vs the actual 3-2.
2-2 by half-time with combined xG 3.87; Palace conceding 24 in 10 and Coventry missing a key defender should have pushed the goal line up.
The winner was an 85' McNeil own goal — random, don't over-read it.
Corners 4/6 were the reverse of the 5/3.8 forecast, with possession-heavy Palace winning more; cards 1/2 slightly below forecast.
16363658.lesson_en: When both defences are poor and a key defender is out, raise over/BTTS probabilities clearly and include 2-2/3-2 in scorelines.

16363659.verdict: 預測方向錯了：我們給 Brighton 59% 勝率，最後 Hull City 2-0 爆冷。半場 0-0 猜中，但兩個進球都在 Costinha 89 分鐘兩黃變一紅之後才出現。
points: 上半場 Brighton 的 xG 是 1.75，Hull City 只有 0.2，Hull City 門將撲出 5 球保住 0-0；下半場形勢反過來，Hull City 的 xG 超過 1.6。只看 Brighton 控球 70% 會誤判，他們的進攻效率在下半場明顯下降。
比賽在最後幾分鐘才決定：Costinha 被罰下後，McBurnie 在 90 分鐘以後連進兩球。這種紅牌加上補時連續進球的情況，模型事前看不到。
犯規偏差最大：預測 Hull City 12 次、Brighton 10 次，實際是 7 次對 17 次，方向完全相反。Brighton 拿到 4 張黃牌和 1 張紅牌，遠高於預測的 1.9 張；Hull City 控球少，大多退守，自己反而少犯規。
角球兩隊都高估了（實際 3 和 4，預測 4.0 和 6.2）。Brighton 雖然控球壓制，但角球並沒有跟著多起來。
16363659.lesson: 強隊控球很多但遲遲進不了球、對手主場又沒輸過時，客隊勝率不要比市場定得太高。另外要考慮強隊因為急躁和反搶而犯規、吃牌，不要預設控球少的一方犯規更多。
16363659.verdict_en: We got the result wrong: we gave Brighton a 59% win chance, but Hull City won 2-0. The 0-0 half-time call was right, but both goals came only after Costinha was sent off for a second yellow on 89'.
points_en: In the first half Brighton had 1.75 xG to Hull City's 0.2, and the Hull City keeper made 5 saves to keep it 0-0. The second half flipped: Hull City passed 1.6 xG. Brighton's 70% possession hides how much their attack faded after the break.
The game was decided at the very end: after Costinha's red card, McBurnie scored twice in stoppage time. A late red card followed by quick goals is something the model cannot see in advance.

Fouls were the biggest miss: we predicted Hull City 12 and Brighton 10, but it finished 7 to 17, the opposite way round. Brighton picked up 4 yellows and 1 red, far above our 1.9 cards. Hull City, with little of the ball, mostly sat deep and fouled less.
We overestimated corners for both teams (actual 3 and 4, predicted 4.0 and 6.2). Brighton's possession did not turn into extra corners.
16363659.lesson_en: When a strong away side dominates the ball but struggles to score against a home team that is unbeaten at home, don't set the away win above the market. Also allow for the stronger side's fouls and cards rising from frustration and counter-pressing, instead of assuming the team with less possession fouls more.

16363660.verdict: 方向對了（看好 Liverpool 勝，概率 55.5%），但比分、角球和犯規分佈都明顯偏離。最大原因是 Yoro 第 8 分鐘被紅牌罰下，賽前模型不可能預見。
points: 勝負方向正確，但預測比分 2-1、半場 0-0；實際 4-0、半場 2-0。Man United 第 8 分鐘少一人後，Liverpool 在 10'、13' 連進兩球，賽前看近六成的大球和雙方進球，只有大球成立。
偏差最大的是角球：預測 5.0 比 4.6，實際 15 比 5。Liverpool 多一人壓著打（控球 64%、射門 28 次、xG 4.38），角球幾乎是預測的三倍，再次證明一隊全面主導時模型會低估角球。
犯規和黃牌方向相反：預測 Man United 犯規 11.5、黃牌 2.6，實際只有 8 次犯規、0 張黃牌。少一人又落後的球隊幾乎沒在搶球，Liverpool 反而犯規 15 次（上半場就 9 次），全場只有 1 張黃牌，裁判 Barrott 執法寬鬆。
半場檢討的更新做得好：主勝 98.1%、比分選項含 4-0、角球上調到 10，方向都對；不過 Liverpool 下半場的角球還是比預期多。
16363660.lesson: 賽前模型看不到紅牌。但遇到實力有差距的球隊，只要半場出現早段紅牌或兩球領先，就該大幅上調領先方的角球和射門，並把落後方的犯規和黃牌往下調。
16363660.verdict_en: Right direction (Liverpool favoured at 55.5%), but the score, corners and fouls were far off. The main cause was Yoro's 8th-minute red card, which no pre-match model could foresee.
points_en: The winner was right, but we predicted 2-1 with 0-0 at half-time; it finished 4-0 (2-0 at HT). After Man United went down to ten in the 8th minute, Liverpool scored at 10' and 13'. Of the near-60% over and BTTS calls, only the over came in.

Corners were the biggest miss: predicted 5.0 vs 4.6, actual 15 vs 5. Liverpool besieged ten men (64% possession, 28 shots, 4.38 xG) and won almost three times our forecast, confirming that the model underrates corners when one side dominates.

Fouls and cards went the opposite way: we expected Man United to commit 11.5 fouls with 2.6 yellows; they had 8 fouls and no yellows. The side that was a man down and trailing barely contested the ball, while Liverpool committed 15 fouls (9 in the first half). Referee Barrott was lenient, with just one yellow all match.

The half-time update worked well: 98.1% home win, 4-0 among the score options and corners raised to 10 were all in the right direction, though Liverpool still won more second-half corners than expected.
16363660.lesson_en: Pre-match models can't see red cards. In a mismatch, once there is an early red card or a two-goal lead at half-time, raise the leading side's corners and shots sharply and cut the trailing side's fouls and cards.

16363661.verdict: 賽前預測 Man City 主勝（65%）落空，比賽以 1-1 平局結束。Man City 的 xG 領先 1.88 對 0.72，但前場效率很差，Fulham 早段進球後一直守住，最後只丟一球。
points: 結果判斷錯誤：預測 Man City 勝、半場 1-0，實際半場 0-1、全場 1-1。比分前三選項都沒有平局，平局只給了 19%，明顯偏低。
Man City 射門 15 次只有 3 次射正。Fulham 只射門 5 次，卻有 4 次射正，第 16 分鐘 Muniz 先進球，打亂了主隊控球壓制的劇本。模型只看 xG，看不到這種臨門一腳的效率差距。
角球方向對了，但數量估錯：Man City 8 個接近預測的 7 個，Fulham 卻有 6 個，比預測的 3.6 多出不少。Fulham 領先後並沒有一直退守，有一定反擊和定位球。
黃牌總數 4 張，接近預測的 3.4 張，多數是 Fulham 的判斷也對。不過 Fulham 3 張黃牌全在上半場（預測上半場只有 0.6 張），可見裁判 Bramall 開場就比預期嚴格。
16363661.lesson: Man City 正處於聯賽三連敗、射門效率低迷的階段，即使賠率很熱也不宜給到 65% 以上，平局機率應提高到 25% 左右，並在比分選項中保留 1-1。
16363661.verdict_en: The Man City win call (65%) failed and the match ended 1-1. City led on xG 1.88 to 0.72 but finished poorly, while Fulham scored early and held on, conceding only once.
points_en: Wrong result: we predicted a City win and 1-0 at half-time; it was 0-1 at the break and 1-1 at full time. None of the top three scorelines was a draw, and the draw got only 19%, clearly too low.

City had 15 shots but only 3 on target. Fulham had just 5 shots, 4 on target, and Muniz scored in the 16th minute, which broke City's possession-dominance script. The model only sees xG, not this gap in finishing.

Corner direction was right but the numbers were off: City's 8 was close to the predicted 7, but Fulham won 6 against the predicted 3.6. After taking the lead, Fulham did not simply sit deep; they still counter-attacked and won set pieces.

Total yellows (4) were close to the predicted 3.4, and most of them going to Fulham was correct. But all 3 Fulham yellows came in the first half (we predicted 0.6 for the first half), so referee Bramall was stricter early on than expected.
16363661.lesson_en: While City are on a three-game league losing run and finishing poorly, don't go above 65% even when the market is heavily on them. Raise the draw to about 25% and keep 1-1 among the top scorelines.

16363662.verdict: 方向判斷錯誤：預測 Arsenal 勝（57%），實際 2-2 平局。半場 0-0 和角球數都錯，只有黃牌總數大致命中。
points: Arsenal 上半場壓制，0-1 領先（xG 1.38 對 0.08）。下半場 Newcastle 在 49' 和 62' 連進兩球反超，全場 xG 1.73 反而高於 Arsenal 的 1.48，說明 Arsenal 領先後控制不住比賽。
角球方向完全相反：預測 4.3 對 5.6，實際 6 對 3，上半場只有 0 對 1。Arsenal 控球 66%，卻沒有轉化成角球，Newcastle 主要靠下半場反撲拿到角球。
犯規大幅低估主隊：預測 13.8 對 10.4，實際 19 對 7。Newcastle 用高強度逼搶和戰術犯規對付 Arsenal 的控球。黃牌預測 2.8 對 2.0，實際 3 對 3，客隊黃牌偏低。
Saka 和 Zubimendi 缺陣，3 天後還有歐冠，下半場的節奏和輪換可能受影響；但模型看不到個別球員，無法量化這些因素。
16363662.lesson: 客隊控球型熱門在高逼搶的主隊主場作客時，平局機率要提高；主隊犯規預測應明顯拉高，角球不要因控球優勢就判給客隊。
16363662.verdict_en: Wrong call: Arsenal were favoured to win (57%) but it finished 2-2. The 0-0 half-time and the corner split were both wrong; only total yellow cards came out roughly right.
points_en: Arsenal dominated the first half and led 0-1 (xG 1.38 vs 0.08). Newcastle scored on 49' and 62' to turn it around, and over the full match their xG of 1.73 beat Arsenal's 1.48, so Arsenal lost control after going ahead.

Corners went the opposite way: forecast 4.3 vs 5.6, actual 6 vs 3, with only 0 vs 1 in the first half. Arsenal had 66% possession but it did not turn into corners; Newcastle won theirs mainly while pushing in the second half.

Home fouls were badly underestimated: forecast 13.8 vs 10.4, actual 19 vs 7. Newcastle pressed hard and used tactical fouls against Arsenal's possession. Yellows were forecast 2.8 vs 2.0 and finished 3 vs 3, so away cards were too low.

Saka and Zubimendi were out, and the Champions League game 3 days later may have affected second-half intensity and rotation; the model cannot see individual players, so these effects can't be quantified.
16363662.lesson_en: When a possession-based away favourite visits a high-pressing home side, raise the draw probability, push the home foul forecast clearly higher, and don't give the corners to the away side just because it will have more of the ball.

16363663.verdict: 預測準確：Tottenham 2-0 正是首選比分，壓制程度也符合預期。
points: 主勝 60% 和首選比分 2-0 都命中；xG 2.69 對 0.38，一面倒的判斷正確。
Ipswich 角球 6 個，遠多於預測的 3 個；全場角球 14 個，高於預測的 10.5 個。
黃牌方向錯了：預測 Ipswich 較多（1.6/2.5），實際 Tottenham 吃 4 張、Ipswich 只有 1 張，雙方犯規都是 17 次。
預測半場 0-0，但 Tottenham 15' 就進球；「上半場效率低」的假設這次不成立。
16363663.lesson: 強隊主場壓制時不要自動把黃牌偏向弱隊，要看強隊球員的犯規習慣和裁判；弱隊的反擊角球也不要壓得太低。
16363663.verdict_en: Accurate: Tottenham 2-0 was the top scoreline and the dominance matched expectations.
points_en: 60% home win and the 2-0 top pick both hit; xG 2.69 vs 0.38 confirmed the one-sided call.
Ipswich won 6 corners vs 3 predicted; total 14 vs 10.5 forecast.
Cards went the wrong way: forecast 1.6/2.5, actual Tottenham 4, Ipswich 1, with 17 fouls each.
HT 0-0 was predicted but Tottenham scored on 15'; the 'slow first half' assumption failed here.
16363663.lesson_en: Don't automatically skew cards toward the weaker side when a big team dominates at home — check the favourite's foul habits and the referee; don't squeeze the underdog's corners too low either.

16363901.verdict: 賽前預測的最可能比分 1-1 命中，勝平負卻偏向主勝（和局只有 26%）；角球和黃牌分佈也明顯失準。
points: 比分 1-1 是賽前首選，進球偏少的判斷正確；不過扳平球是 Z. Suzuki 的烏龍球，這類進球帶有運氣成分，不能算模型讀對了比賽。
半場預測 0-0 不中：N. Jackson 39 分鐘進球。上半場角球 5-2，維拉明顯壓着打，遠高於預測的 2.2 對 2.9。
全場角球 7-7，共 14 個，高於預測的 9.8；維拉角球更是低估了接近 3 個。犯規 7 對 12，維拉的犯規比預測少了 3.5 次，富勒姆則大致準確。
黃牌 1-3：富勒姆上半場已吃兩張，維拉全場只有 1 張，主隊黃牌高估、客隊低估。半場檢討把富勒姆黃牌上調到 2.9，方向正確。
xG 方面富勒姆 2.21 反而高過維拉 1.71，下半場客隊明顯反撲。半場時給主勝 68%，對領先一球的優勢估計過度樂觀。
16363901.lesson: 兩隊實力接近、預期進球偏少時，和局機率應給到 30% 左右；半場只領先一球時不要把主勝推到接近七成。另外，壓迫較多的一方犯規和黃牌通常較少，客隊的牌數應該上調。
16363901.verdict_en: The pre-match top scoreline of 1-1 was correct, but the 1X2 leaned toward a home win (draw only 26%), and the corner and card splits were clearly off.
points_en: 1-1 was the first-choice pre-match scoreline and the low-scoring read held up; however, the equaliser was a Z. Suzuki own goal, which involves luck, so it does not prove the model read the game well.
The 0-0 half-time call missed: N. Jackson scored on 39'. Villa took first-half corners 5-2 while on top, far above the predicted 2.2 vs 2.9.

Full-time corners were 7-7, 14 in total, above the predicted 9.8; Villa's corners were underestimated by almost 3. Fouls were 7 vs 12: Villa committed 3.5 fewer than predicted, while Fulham's count was roughly right.

Cards finished 1-3: Fulham already had two yellows in the first half and Villa got only one all match, so home cards were overestimated and away cards underestimated. The half-time update raising Fulham to 2.9 cards was the right direction.
On xG, Fulham's 2.21 actually beat Villa's 1.71, with the visitors clearly pushing back in the second half. The 68% home-win figure at half-time was too optimistic for a one-goal lead.
16363901.lesson_en: When two teams are close and expected goals are low, give the draw around 30%, and don't push a one-goal half-time lead to nearly 70% for the leader. The side applying more pressure usually commits fewer fouls and gets fewer cards, so raise the away team's card count.

16363902.verdict: 主勝方向正確（44%，三個結果中最高），但預測估得太接近；伯恩茅斯射正5比1，2-0贏得穩陣。
points: 勝平負方向命中；首選比分1-1落空，1-0和2-1都在候選內，實際是2-0。
角球預測主5.0、客4.3，實際4比4，偏差不大；上半場角球2比1也接近預測。
犯規12比15，利茲聯比預測多；黃牌2比2，和預測的2.0/1.9幾乎一樣，Salisbury 出牌少的判斷正確。
利茲聯控球56%，但xG只有0.67、射正1次，印證了「進球能力一般」的判斷；Evanilson 31分鐘進球後，利茲聯始終攻不破對方防線。
16363902.lesson: 狀態火熱的主隊對進球少的客隊時，應該調低和局機率，把1-0、2-0排在1-1前面。
16363902.verdict_en: Home-win direction was right (44%, the highest of the three outcomes), but the forecast was too close-call; Bournemouth won 2-0 comfortably with 5 shots on target to 1.
points_en: 1X2 direction hit; top scoreline 1-1 missed, 1-0 and 2-1 were listed, actual 2-0.
Corners forecast 5.0/4.3 vs actual 4/4, small error; 1H corners 2/1 also close.
Fouls 12/15, with Leeds above forecast; cards 2/2 almost exactly matched 2.0/1.9, confirming Salisbury's low card rate.
Leeds had 56% possession but only 0.67 xG and 1 shot on target, confirming their weak attack; after Evanilson's 31' goal they never broke Bournemouth down.
16363902.lesson_en: When an in-form home side meets a low-scoring visitor, cut the draw probability and rank 1-0/2-0 above 1-1.

16363903.verdict: 主勝方向命中（46%），但布倫特福德全場xG只有0.46，靠烏龍球和一次把握機會取勝，贏得幸運。
points: 勝平負方向正確，比分候選有1-0，實際2-0；30分鐘 Milenković 的烏龍球是模型無法預計的偶然事件。
犯規偏差最大：布倫特福德全場只犯規6次（預測12.8），森林犯規17次（預測12.5）；領先後主隊退守，追分的森林多犯規。
黃牌1比3，同樣是追分一方出牌多，總數4張和預測的4.2接近，但分佈錯了。
角球3比4，兩隊都低於預測的5.0，雙方都缺乏攻擊性，整場比賽很悶。
16363903.lesson: 早段領先的一方犯規和黃牌會明顯減少，追分一方增加；先進球的機會高時，犯規和黃牌預測應向落後一方傾斜。
16363903.verdict_en: Home-win call hit (46%), but Brentford produced only 0.46 xG and won via an own goal plus one finished chance – a fortunate win.
points_en: 1X2 direction right and 1-0 was among the scorelines, actual 2-0; Milenković's 30' own goal was a random event no model can foresee.
Fouls were the biggest miss: Brentford committed only 6 (forecast 12.8) and Forest 17 (forecast 12.5); the leading home side sat back while chasing Forest fouled more.
Cards 1/3 – again skewed to the chasing side; the total of 4 matched the 4.2 forecast but the split was wrong.
Corners 3/4, both under the 5.0 forecast; neither side was very attacking in a dull game.
16363903.lesson_en: The team that leads early fouls and gets booked much less while the chasing side does more; when one side is likely to score first, tilt foul/card forecasts toward the trailing team.

16363904.verdict: 賽前輕微看好切爾西的方向正確，但比分、犯規同黃牌都估得太保守；半場檢討時被曼聯上半場的 xG 誤導，反而轉向看淡切爾西，結果失準。
points: 勝負：賽前切爾西勝 44% 屬最大機會，方向命中；但三個熱門比分（1-1、2-1、1-2）都假設曼聯會進球，實際曼聯零進球，切爾西 2-0 贏。
下半場轉捩點是 50 分鐘 Rogers 開紀錄，之後 L. Martínez 在 59 分鐘和 63 分鐘連吃兩黃被逐，切爾西一分鐘後就由 Palmer 射入點球。紅牌加早段進球令比賽一面倒，模型完全看不到這類事件。
犯規和黃牌偏差最大：曼聯犯規 20 次（預測 11.8）、黃牌 6 張加 1 紅（預測 2.7）。全場合共 7 黃 1 紅，比原先估計的約 5 張還多；Bankes 執法偏嚴，加上落後一方追分時心急，牌數急升。
半場檢討太倚重上半場 xG（曼聯 1.01 對 0.28），把切爾西勝率降到 24%，忽略了切爾西主場控球佔優、陣容有較強的下半場調整能力；角球方面，上半場曼聯 6 對 3，最後全場卻是切爾西 8 對 7。
16363904.lesson: 遇上執法偏嚴的裁判（例如 Bankes）而且雙方實力接近時，客隊的犯規和黃牌要估高一點；半場檢討不應單憑上半場 xG 大幅推翻賽前判斷，比分仍是 0-0 時，主隊的勝率不宜砍得太多。
16363904.verdict_en: The pre-match lean towards Chelsea was right, but the scoreline, fouls and cards were badly underestimated; the half-time update was swayed by United's first-half xG and wrongly turned against Chelsea.
points_en: Result: Chelsea at 44% was the most likely outcome and it came true, but all three top scorelines (1-1, 2-1, 1-2) had United scoring, while the actual result was a 2-0 Chelsea clean sheet.

The turning point came after the break: Rogers scored on 50', L. Martínez was sent off for two yellows (59', 63'), and Palmer converted a penalty a minute later. The early second-half goal plus the red card made the game one-sided, and the model cannot see events like these.

Fouls and cards had the biggest miss: United committed 20 fouls (predicted 11.8) and got 6 yellows plus a red (predicted 2.7). The match total of 7 yellows and 1 red was even above the ~5 cards expected. Bankes was strict, and United chased the game.

The half-time update leaned too heavily on United's first-half xG (1.01 vs 0.28) and cut Chelsea's win chance to 24%. It ignored Chelsea's home possession edge and their stronger ability to adjust in the second half. Corners also flipped: United led 6-3 at half-time, but Chelsea finished ahead 8-7.
16363904.lesson_en: With a strict referee like Bankes in a tight big-team match, push the away side's fouls and cards higher. At half-time, don't overturn the pre-match view on first-half xG alone; at 0-0, keep the home side's win probability from dropping too far.

16363905.verdict: 預測錯誤：賽前看好桑德蘭（38%），結果考文垂以xG 0.71入3球，3-1大勝。
points: 考文垂xG只有0.71卻入了3球，射正4次入3球，臨門一腳遠超預期；桑德蘭xG 1.65只入了一個點球。
半場預測0-0，實際2-0；Sakamoto 17分鐘早段進球打亂了「兩隊進攻都弱」的劇本。
考文垂犯規16次，遠多過預測的11.5，領先後以犯規拖慢節奏；Alderete 90分鐘才兩黃變紅，對比賽結果沒有影響。
角球4比4，和預測的4.2/4.8大致吻合，黃牌總數4張也接近。
16363905.lesson: 不要過度依賴市場看好客隊；兩隊進攻都弱時，和局及主隊勝的機率應該更接近，並保留一方臨門一腳異常好的可能。
16363905.verdict_en: Wrong call: Sunderland were favoured (38%), but Coventry turned 0.71 xG into three goals and won 3-1.
points_en: Coventry scored 3 from 4 shots on target on just 0.71 xG – huge finishing overperformance; Sunderland's 1.65 xG yielded only a penalty.
HT forecast 0-0, actual 2-0; Sakamoto's early 17' goal broke the 'both attacks weak' script.
Coventry committed 16 fouls vs 11.5 forecast, slowing the game once ahead; Alderete's second yellow came only at 90' and did not affect the result.
Corners 4/4 broadly matched 4.2/4.8, and total cards (4) were also close.
16363905.lesson_en: Don't lean too hard on a market-favoured away side; when both attacks are weak, keep draw and home-win probabilities closer and allow for a hot finishing day.

16363906.verdict: 2-2和局，賽前三個結果的機率很平均，可算大致合理；但半場時改判伊普斯維奇58%勝出就錯了。
points: 賽前給和局28%、首選比分1-1，方向接近，實際是更多進球的2-2；半場改判客勝58%，忽略了赫爾城主場反撲的能力。
黃牌偏差最大：實際6張（3比3），預測4.3張；下半場出了5張牌，比賽到後段變得激烈。
角球赫爾城6個（預測4.4）、伊普斯維奇3個（預測4.6）；落後的主隊在下半場追分時多開角球。
伊普斯維奇控球62%、xG 1.02，但只射正3次，壓制未能轉化為優勢，McBurnie 和 Iroegbunam 10分鐘內連入兩球反超。
16363906.lesson: 半場時只領先一球、xG差距又不大，不應大幅調高領先一方的勝率；落後的主隊下半場角球和黃牌都會增加。
16363906.verdict_en: A 2-2 draw – the pre-match probabilities were fairly even and broadly reasonable, but the half-time switch to a 58% Ipswich win was wrong.
points_en: Pre-match gave the draw 28% with 1-1 as top scoreline, close in spirit; actual was a higher-scoring 2-2. The HT update to 58% away win ignored Hull's ability to fight back at home.
Cards were the biggest miss: 6 actual (3/3) vs 4.3 forecast; 5 came in the second half as the game got heated.
Corners: Hull 6 (forecast 4.4), Ipswich 3 (forecast 4.6) – the trailing home side won more corners while chasing.
Ipswich had 62% possession and 1.02 xG but only 3 shots on target; McBurnie and Iroegbunam then scored twice in 10 minutes to turn it around.
16363906.lesson_en: At half-time, a one-goal lead with a small xG gap should not push the leader's win probability up too far; a trailing home side's second-half corners and cards rise.

16363907.verdict: 方向判斷正確：客勝是最高機率選項，0-1 也列在第二個比分選項中；黃牌數量明顯低估，角球的分布也預測反了。
points: 勝平負給阿森納 41%，是三個選項中最高的，賽果 0-1 也在比分選項中；半場預測 0-0，但 Havertz 第 16 分鐘就進球，半場比分沒有猜中。
偏差最大的是黃牌：賽前預測總共約 4.2 張，實際 8 張，而且 7 張出現在下半場，80 分鐘後就有 4 張；連半場時更新的 3.5 張也還是太低。
角球總數 11 個，和預測的 10.2 個接近，但分布相反：利物浦落後後一直壓上，上半場角球 6-1，主隊 7 個角球遠高於預測的 4.9 個，阿森納只有 4 個。
利物浦射門 17 次卻只有 1 次射正，xG 也只有 1.15；落後追分時射門很多，但機會品質低。阿森納領先後退守，犯規 18-10 也主要來自主隊的逼搶。
16363907.lesson: 強隊對決如果一方早早領先，要把黃牌總數上調到比裁判場均更高（下半場和比賽末段尤其要加），角球也要往落後追分的一方傾斜。
16363907.verdict_en: Right direction: the away win was the top pick and 0-1 was the second scoreline listed. Cards were badly underestimated and the corner split came out the wrong way round.
points_en: Arsenal at 41% was the most likely of the three outcomes and 0-1 was among the listed scorelines. The 0-0 half-time call missed because Havertz scored in the 16th minute.
The biggest miss was yellow cards: about 4.2 predicted, 8 shown, 7 of them after half-time and 4 after the 80th minute. Even the half-time update of 3.5 was too low.

Total corners (11) were close to the forecast of 10.2, but the split was reversed. Liverpool pushed forward from behind and led 6-1 on corners in the first half, finishing with 7 against a forecast of 4.9; Arsenal had only 4.
Liverpool had 17 shots but only 1 on target (xG 1.15): plenty of volume while chasing, little quality. Arsenal sat deep after taking the lead, and Liverpool's pressing drove the 18-10 foul count.
16363907.lesson_en: In a tight big-team match where one side scores early, push the card total above the referee's average (especially for the second half and the closing minutes), and shift the corner forecast towards the team chasing the game.

16363908.verdict: 大冷門：預測曼城勝出（55%），結果布萊頓靠 Ayari 11分鐘進球1-0贏。
points: 曼城射門21次、xG 1.92，進球數低於表現，而 Ayari 早段進球後布萊頓退守，這種偶然性模型看不到。
角球8比2，曼城比預測的6.2多、布萊頓比預測的4.0少；一方壓制時角球差距被低估，是已知偏差。
黃牌0比3，曼城預測1.5張卻一張都沒有；布萊頓領先也出了3張牌，因為長時間防守要犯規阻止反擊。
Pawson 預計每場5張黃牌，實際只有3張，全場犯規22次，也低於他平均的27次。
16363908.lesson: 強隊主場面對防守紮實的對手，勝率不宜高於55%；一方控球壓制時，角球預測要拉開差距，被壓制一方的角球要調低。
16363908.verdict_en: Big upset: Man City were favoured (55%) but Brighton won 1-0 through Ayari's 11th-minute goal.
points_en: City had 21 shots and 1.92 xG but scored nothing, while Brighton sat deep after Ayari's early goal – randomness the model cannot see.
Corners 8/2: City above the 6.2 forecast, Brighton well below 4.0; the corner gap is underestimated when one side dominates, a known bias.
Cards 0/3: City were forecast 1.5 but got none; Brighton still collected 3 while leading, as long spells of defending meant fouling to stop counters.
Pawson was expected to show about 5 yellows but showed 3, and total fouls (22) were below his 27 average.
16363908.lesson_en: Cap a big home favourite near 55% against a well-organised defence, and widen the predicted corner gap when one side dominates possession, cutting the pinned-back side's corners.

16363909.verdict: 賽前看好 Newcastle 小勝（41%），結果 Everton 1-0 客勝，賽前判斷錯誤；半場檢討已改為傾向平局或 Everton 小勝，比較接近實際。
points: 半場 0-0 預測正確。Everton 上半場 xG 就領先（0.92 對 0.21），全場 xG 2.15 對 1.47、射正 5 對 2，客勝有場面支持，不是運氣。
黃牌總數預測 5.1 張，實際 6 張加 1 張紅牌，大致準確；但其中 3 張（含 Ramsey 兩黃變一紅）都在 90 分鐘後 Newcastle 落後追分時出現，屬於比賽尾段的情況。
角球預測 10.8 個，實際 9 個；上半場預測 5.4 個，實際只有 2 個，Everton 上半場一個角球都沒有，賽前因為過去低估而調高的修正，這場反而調過頭。
Newcastle 主場疲軟、4 天前聯賽杯 1-3 輸給同一個對手，這兩個信號賽前都已經寫進理由，卻仍然給主隊 41% 勝率，近期對戰和主場劣勢的權重明顯給得不夠。
16363909.lesson: When a home side has been losing the xG battle at home all season and just lost to the same opponent, cut the home-win probability clearly instead of trusting the home edge on paper. Decide the corner upward fix based on both teams' styles, not by default.
16363909.verdict_en: The pre-match call leaned Newcastle (41%), but Everton won 1-0 away, so the pre-match call was wrong. The half-time update shifted toward a draw or a narrow Everton win, which was closer.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time call was right. Everton already led on xG in the first half (0.92 vs 0.21), and the full match ended 2.15 vs 1.47 xG with 5 vs 2 shots on target, so the away win was deserved, not luck.

We predicted 5.1 yellow cards; there were 6 plus a red, so roughly right. But 3 cards, including Ramsey's second yellow, came after 90 minutes while Newcastle chased the game, which is late-game chaos.
We predicted 10.8 corners and there were 9. In the first half we predicted 5.4 and there were only 2, with Everton taking none, so our usual upward fix for corners overshot this time.

Newcastle's weak home form and their 1-3 League Cup home loss to the same opponent 4 days earlier were both in the reasoning, yet the home side still got 41%. Recent meetings and the poor home form were not weighted enough.

16363910.verdict: 勝負方向和 2-0 比分都在預測範圍內（主勝 57%，2-0 是第三選擇），但 Mateta 13 分鐘被逐，令角球、控球和射門數據遠超賽前預測。
points: 結果對：熱刺 2-0 贏，2-0 列在預測比分第三位；半場預測 0-0，實際 Gray 25 分鐘進球，熱刺 1-0 領先。
偏差最大是角球：預測 6.6 比 3.8，實際 20 比 0。水晶宮打十人後全面退守，熱刺控球 79%、射門 34 次，角球自然大增。
犯規比預測少（預測 12.5 比 11，實際 8 比 10）：一邊倒的比賽，對抗不多。黃牌總數 2 張，大致符合 Oliver 出牌少的判斷。
早段紅牌是模型看不到的因素。半場更新已改為主勝 88%、角球 11 比 1.5，方向正確，但熱刺的角球仍然估少。
16363910.lesson: 強隊對防線不穩的球隊，而對手又有機會早段少一人時，角球分佈要預留大幅一邊倒的空間；半場更新時如果對方只剩十人，強隊的全場角球可以估到 12 以上。
16363910.verdict_en: Direction and the 2-0 scoreline were in range (57% home win, 2-0 our third pick), but Mateta's 13th-minute red card pushed corners, possession and shots far beyond the pre-match forecast.
points_en: Result correct: Tottenham won 2-0, our third-listed score. We predicted 0-0 at half-time, but Gray scored on 25' for a 1-0 Spurs lead.
Biggest miss was corners: predicted 6.6-3.8, actual 20-0. Down to ten men, Palace sat deep while Spurs had 79% of the ball and 34 shots.
Fouls came in lower than expected (predicted 12.5-11, actual 8-10) because the one-sided game had few duels. Two yellows in total fits the read that Oliver shows few cards.
The early red card was invisible to the model. The half-time update (88% home win, corners 11-1.5) moved the right way but still underestimated Spurs' corners.
16363910.lesson_en: When a strong side faces a leaky defence and the opponent may go down to ten early, allow for a very lopsided corner split. In a half-time update against ten men, project 12+ full-time corners for the dominant side.
16363910._note: Reviewed in the CLI; no files were changed and nothing was looked up online.

16363911.verdict: Arsenal 主勝方向命中，1-0 也在比分前三選項之內，但進攻效率遠低於預期，黃牌和犯規都集中在 Hull City，這一點判斷正確。
points: 主勝和零封都猜對：Hull City 全場只有 2 次射正，xG 0.34，模型對客隊進攻的判斷準確。
Arsenal 射門 21 次、射正 10 次，xG 卻只有 1.08，大量射門都是低質量機會；在缺少 Saka 的情況下，預測的 2-0 偏樂觀。
上半場角球 1 比 3，和預測的 3.6 比 1.6 相反；全場角球 7 比 4 和預測接近，Arsenal 的壓制主要集中在下半場。
Hull City 拿了 5 張黃牌，比預測的 2.8 多不少，下半場深度防守時的戰術犯規累積成牌；犯規 15 次也高於預測的 12.5。
16363911.lesson: When a key wide attacker like Saka is out and the opponent sits deep in a 5-3-2, trim the favourite's goal total and first-half corners, and expect the pinned-back side's cards to build up after half-time.
16363911.verdict_en: Arsenal win and clean sheet called correctly, and 1-0 was among the top-3 scores, but the attack was far less efficient than expected; fouls and cards concentrating on Hull City was right.
points_en: Home win and clean sheet were right: Hull City had only 2 shots on target and 0.34 xG, so the read on their attack was accurate.
Arsenal took 21 shots (10 on target) but produced only 1.08 xG, mostly low-quality chances; without Saka the 2-0 pick was optimistic.
First-half corners were 1-3, the reverse of the predicted 3.6-1.6; full-time corners (7-4) were close, as Arsenal's pressure came mainly after the break.
Hull City got 5 yellows vs the predicted 2.8, as tactical fouls piled up while they sat deep in the second half; their 15 fouls also beat the predicted 12.5.

16363912.verdict: 勝負方向對了（Brighton 勝 47%），但第 23 分鐘的紅牌讓比賽變成一邊倒，比分、半場和角球都低估了。
points: Brentford 的 Thiago 第 23 分鐘被紅牌罰下，之後 Brighton 控球 75%、射門 20 比 5，這一點模型無法預見。
賽前判斷半場 0-0，實際上半場已經 2-0（第 15 分鐘進球加第 42 分鐘點球），早段進球打破了低比分的假設。
黃牌實際 4-2，遠高於預測的 1.9-2.1，說明 Michael Oliver 給牌少的印象在這場不成立，紅牌之後比賽也更激烈。
Brighton 角球 7 個高於預測的 5.4，再次說明一方壓制時角球會被低估。
16363912.lesson: When the home side is clearly stronger, don't push the draw too high because the away side draws a lot on the road, and don't cut cards too much for a 'lenient' referee.
16363912.verdict_en: Right direction (Brighton win at 47%), but a 23rd-minute red card made it one-way traffic, so the score, half-time and corners were all underestimated.
points_en: Brentford's Thiago was sent off in the 23rd minute; after that Brighton had 75% possession and outshot them 20-5, which the model could not foresee.
We predicted 0-0 at half-time, but it was already 2-0 (a 15th-minute goal plus a 42nd-minute penalty), so the early goal broke the low-scoring assumption.
Yellow cards were 4-2, far above the predicted 1.9-2.1; Michael Oliver's low-card reputation did not hold here, and the red card made the game more heated.
Brighton's 7 corners beat the predicted 5.4, again showing corners are underestimated when one side dominates.
16363912.lesson_en: When the home side is clearly stronger, don't push the draw too high because the away side draws a lot on the road, and don't cut cards too much for a 'lenient' referee.

16363913.verdict: Liverpool 客勝判斷正確（60%），但進球數被壓得太低，Liverpool 犯規和黃牌也明顯多於預測。
points: 實際比分 1-3，總共 4 球；賽前用 Liverpool 本季場均只進 1.2 球的理由壓低總進球，結果錯了。Wirtz、Isak 等主力全部首發時進攻火力更強。
雙方 xG 合計約 5（2.38 比 2.65），比賽很開放，Crystal Palace 缺 Mateta 仍然創造了不少機會。
Liverpool 犯規 18 次、黃牌 4 張，遠高於預測的 10.7 次和 2.2 張；客隊領先後用戰術犯規拖節奏。
上半場角球 2-5，Liverpool 上半場的壓制力比預測的 2.9 個角球更強。
16363913.lesson: When a strong side starts its full first XI against a weak defence, don't set total goals below the market just because of its season scoring average.
16363913.verdict_en: Liverpool away win called correctly (60%), but total goals were set too low, and Liverpool's fouls and cards were clearly underestimated.
points_en: The final score was 1-3, four goals in total; we cut total goals because Liverpool averaged only 1.2 goals a game, which was wrong. With Wirtz, Isak and the rest of the first team starting, the attack was much sharper.
Combined xG was about 5 (2.38 vs 2.65), so the game was very open; Crystal Palace still created plenty without Mateta.
Liverpool committed 18 fouls and got 4 yellows, far above the predicted 10.7 and 2.2; the away side used tactical fouls to slow the game once ahead.
First-half corners were 2-5, so Liverpool's first-half pressure was stronger than the predicted 2.9 corners.
16363913.lesson_en: When a strong side starts its full first XI against a weak defence, don't set total goals below the market just because of its season scoring average.

16363914.verdict: 主勝方向判斷正確，但總進球、犯規和角球都明顯偏離：比賽下半場打開，進球比預期多，角球和犯規卻少很多。
points: 勝平負給主勝 56%，結果 Everton 3-1 獲勝；半場 0-0 也預測準確，但半場檢討把平局調高到 39%、主勝降到 35%，方向反而調錯了。
總進球只預測約 2.5 球，前三個比分是 1-0、2-0、1-1，實際打出 4 球；Coventry 52' 先進球後被迫壓上，Everton 利用空檔由 T. Barry 在 5 分鐘內連進兩球，這種先失球後打開局面的走勢，模型看不到。
角球預測合計 9.5 個，實際只有 4 個，雙方各 2 個；兩隊射門合計 31 次，但很多是直接射門，沒有形成角球，所以射門多不代表角球多。
犯規預測合計 22 次，實際只有 15 次，Coventry 只有 6 次（預測 12.5 次）；黃牌也只有 2 張，兩張都在 88' 才出現，裁判 Attwell 本季場均 5.8 張黃牌的數據這次完全不準。
16363914.lesson: At 0-0 with even xG at half-time, don't push the draw up sharply, because second halves often open up; base corners and fouls on both teams' playing styles, not just the referee's average or home dominance.
16363914.verdict_en: Right on the home win, but goals, fouls and corners were well off: the match opened up after the break, with more goals and far fewer corners and fouls than expected.
points_en: We gave the home win 56% and Everton won 3-1; the 0-0 half-time call was also right, but the half-time update raised the draw to 39% and cut the home win to 35%, which moved the wrong way.

We expected about 2.5 total goals, with 1-0, 2-0 and 1-1 as the top scorelines, but the match had 4 goals; Coventry's 52' opener made them push forward, and T. Barry scored twice in five minutes on the counter-space. The model cannot see that kind of game-state swing.
We predicted 9.5 corners and there were only 4 (2 each); 31 total shots mostly ended as direct attempts rather than corners, so lots of shots did not mean lots of corners.
We predicted 22 fouls and there were 15, with Coventry committing only 6 (we said 12.5); there were just 2 yellows, both at 88', so Attwell's 5.8 cards-per-game average did not apply here.

16363915.verdict: 首選比分 1-1 和半場 0-0 都命中，但 Fulham 的主場進攻優勢被高估，角球明顯少於預期。
points: 1-1 是賽前首選比分，半場 0-0 也猜中；兩個進球都在 80 分鐘後，比賽前段很沉悶。
Fulham 控球 58%，但 xG 只有 0.62，低於 Newcastle 的 0.91；預測的主場 xG 優勢沒有出現，給主勝 47% 偏高。
全場角球只有 3 比 3（預測 6.5 比 4.2），是偏差最大的一項；Fulham 的主場角球數據沒有轉化出來。
黃牌只有 2 張，而且都在第 90 分鐘，符合裁判 Robert Jones 給牌少的特點，Fulham 甚至 0 張；犯規總數 22 次，也低於他的場均水準。
16363915.lesson: In an even, slow-tempo match, lower the total corners instead of copying the home side's home corner average; Newcastle's absences did not mean Fulham would create more chances.
16363915.verdict_en: Top score pick 1-1 and HT 0-0 both hit, but Fulham's home attacking edge was overrated and corners came in well below expectation.
points_en: 1-1 was the top pick and 0-0 at half-time was correct; both goals came after the 80th minute in a slow game.
Fulham had 58% possession but only 0.62 xG vs Newcastle's 0.91; the expected home xG edge never appeared, so 47% for a home win was too high.
Corners finished just 3-3 (predicted 6.5-4.2), the biggest miss; Fulham's home corner average did not carry over.
Only 2 yellows, both in the 90th minute, fitting referee Robert Jones's low card rate (Fulham got none); total fouls (22) were also below his average.

16363916.verdict: Bournemouth 客勝判斷正確，比分也接近 1-2 這個選項；但第 5 分鐘就進球，半場 0-0 的判斷不對，Bournemouth 的犯規也嚴重低估。
points: Evanilson 第 5 分鐘進球，加上第 46 分鐘的烏龍球，賽前因為賽程密集而略微下調客勝的做法偏保守。
Bournemouth 犯規 20 次（上半場 8 次），Ipswich 只有 6 次，預測的 11.3 對 11.0 錯得很多。領先的客隊用高壓搶斷和戰術犯規打亂對手。
Ipswich 上半場 0 個角球、全場 2 個，證實了主場角球少的判斷，甚至還不到預測的 3.3 個。
比分選項 1-2 在前三名之內，進球結構大致接近。
16363916.lesson: A European side playing 4 games in 14 days isn't necessarily tired; when the market keeps backing them, don't discount too much for fixtures.
16363916.verdict_en: Bournemouth away win called correctly and 1-2 was among our scorelines, but the 5th-minute goal made the 0-0 half-time call wrong, and Bournemouth's fouls were badly underestimated.
points_en: Evanilson scored in the 5th minute and an own goal followed in the 46th; trimming the away win for fixture congestion was too cautious.
Bournemouth committed 20 fouls (8 in the first half) to Ipswich's 6, far off the predicted 11.3 vs 11.0; the leading away side used pressing and tactical fouls to break up play.
Ipswich had 0 corners in the first half and 2 in total, confirming the low home-corner read and even falling short of the predicted 3.3.
1-2 was in our top three scorelines, so the goal pattern was roughly right.
16363916.lesson_en: A European side playing 4 games in 14 days isn't necessarily tired; when the market keeps backing them, don't discount too much for fixtures.

16363917.verdict: 賽前看好 Tottenham 小勝（40%），結果 Leeds 主場 1-0 獲勝；半場 0-0 預測正確，半場後把平局調高到 40% 也沒有說中，但比分選項中有 1-0。
points: 勝負方向錯：Leeds 雖然控球只有 39%，xG 卻是 2.02 對 0.77，射門 16 對 7，場面優勢比市場和模型估計的大得多，Tottenham 控球多但威脅少。
角球偏差最大的是 Leeds：預測 3.9 個，實際 6 個；Tottenham 預測 6.0 個，實際 4 個，角球向客隊傾斜的判斷反了，全場總數 10 個和預測（9.9 個）大致相同。
犯規和黃牌接近：Tottenham 犯規 15 次，比預測（12.6 次）多，全場黃牌 5 張，和預測的 5.0 張一致；裁判 John Brooks 牌多的判斷有效，上半場黃牌（1-1）也很接近。
半場時兩隊合計 xG 只有 0.41，看起來是低節奏比賽，但下半場 Leeds 明顯加強進攻，79 分鐘 Okafor 進球；半場檢討太依賴上半場的低節奏，低估了主隊下半場的提升。
16363917.lesson: When the market sharply shortens the away price, don't follow it blindly. An unbeaten home side playing on the counter against a possession-heavy big club can still dominate on shots and corners, so don't read possession as control.
16363917.verdict_en: Pre-match leaned Tottenham (40%) but Leeds won 1-0 at home; the 0-0 half-time call was right, and the half-time update's shift to a 40% draw also missed, though 1-0 was among the listed scores.
points_en: Wrong result direction: Leeds had only 39% possession yet won xG 2.02 to 0.77 and shots 16 to 7, so their edge was far bigger than the market or model expected. Tottenham's possession was mostly sterile.

The biggest miss was Leeds corners: predicted 3.9, actual 6. Tottenham were predicted 6.0 and got 4, so the corner tilt toward the away side was reversed, though the 10 total was close to the forecast of 9.9.

Fouls and cards were close: Tottenham committed 15 fouls (vs 12.6 predicted), and the 5 total yellows matched the 5.0 forecast. The John Brooks card uplift was justified, and first-half yellows (1-1) were also close.

At half-time the combined xG was only 0.41, which looked like a low-tempo game, but Leeds stepped up after the break and Okafor scored in the 79th minute. The half-time review leaned too much on the slow first half and underrated the home side's second-half push.

16363918.verdict: 勝平負方向偏向 Man United，結果打成 4-4 平局；總進球、角球差距和犯規都嚴重低估，只有黃牌偏多這一點方向錯得更明顯。
points: 比分預測 1-1/2-1/1-0、半場 0-0，實際上半場已經 2-2、全場 8 球。開場 4 分鐘 Aston Villa 連進兩球，比賽一開始就變成對攻，按守則把總進球下調 0.4 球反而錯得更遠。
兩隊各有一個點球（16' Bruno Fernandes、48' McGinn），雙方 xG 合計 6.4，遠高於賽前預期。這種早段進球加點球帶來的連鎖效應，Poisson 基準看不到。
角球 8-1、射門 26-12，Man United 落後時長時間壓迫，角球差距比預測的 6.2-3.6 懸殊得多，再次印證一方主導時角球會被低估。犯規 18-9 也明顯偏向 Man United 一方。
裁判 Kavanagh 場均 5.5 張黃牌，全場卻只出示 2 張，上半場 0 張。進球多、節奏開放的比賽，戰術犯規和爭議反而少，裁判數據高估了黃牌。
16363918.lesson: 兩隊後防都有缺陣（Martínez、Cash 停賽）時，不要按守則機械下調總進球；比賽開局就有進球、變成對攻時，黃牌預測要下調，主導一方的角球和犯規要上調。
16363918.verdict_en: The 1X2 leaned Man United but the match ended 4-4; total goals, the corner gap and fouls were badly underestimated, and the high card call was the most clearly wrong.
points_en: We predicted 1-1/2-1/1-0 with 0-0 at half-time; it was 2-2 at the break and 8 goals in total. Aston Villa scored twice in the first 4 minutes, turning it into an open end-to-end game, so the rule-based 0.4-goal cut made us even more wrong.
Each side got a penalty (Bruno Fernandes 16', McGinn 48') and combined xG reached 6.4, far above expectations. The Poisson baseline cannot see this chain reaction from early goals and penalties.

Corners were 8-1 and shots 26-12 as Man United pushed while chasing the game, a far bigger gap than the predicted 6.2-3.6. This confirms again that corners are underestimated when one side dominates. Fouls were also lopsided at 18-9.
Referee Kavanagh averages 5.5 yellows, but only 2 were shown, none in the first half. Open, high-scoring games produce fewer tactical fouls and flashpoints, so the referee profile overstated cards.
16363918.lesson_en: When both defences are weakened (Martínez and Cash suspended), don't cut total goals mechanically by rule; once early goals make a game open, lower the card estimate and raise the dominant side's corners and fouls.

16363919.verdict: 預測完全錯誤：賽前看好 Man City 客勝（54%），首選比分 0-1，結果 Nott'm Forest 主場 3-1 爆冷，半場已經 2-0。
points: 勝負方向錯了：Nott'm Forest 只拿到 22% 控球和 0.98 xG，卻有 5 次射正、進了 3 球。Man City 的 xG 是 1.57，高於對手但不算多，壓制沒有轉化成進球。
半場預測 0-0 被第 6 分鐘和第 18 分鐘兩個早段進球打破。之後 Man City 只能長時間控球進攻，比賽節奏也跟賽前假設不同。
角球偏差不大：預測 4.2 比 5.6，實際 3 比 7，往客隊傾斜的方向對了，只是 Man City 的角球還是低估了一點。
黃牌偏差最大：預測 Nott'm Forest 2.1 張，實際 4 張，而且全在下半場領先時拿到（拖延和戰術犯規）。Man City 預測 1.6 張，實際 0 張。裁判 Barrott 給牌偏少這點，抵不過領先方下半場拖時間的影響。
16363919.lesson: 主場防守反擊的球隊打控球型熱門時，不要只看主場進球荒和 xG 就壓低主隊勝率；一旦主隊早段領先，要預期領先方黃牌明顯增加、落後方角球增加。
16363919.verdict_en: A clear miss: we favoured a Man City away win (54%) with 0-1 as the top score, but Nott'm Forest won 3-1 at home and led 2-0 at half-time.
points_en: Wrong result: Nott'm Forest had only 22% possession and 0.98 xG, yet put 5 shots on target and scored 3. Man City's 1.57 xG was higher but not dominant, and their control did not turn into goals.
The 0-0 half-time call was broken by early goals in the 6th and 18th minutes. After that Man City were forced into long spells of possession, a different game from the one we assumed.
Corners were roughly right: we predicted 4.2 vs 5.6 and the actual was 3 vs 7. Leaning towards the away side was correct, but Man City's count was still underestimated.

Cards were the biggest miss: we predicted 2.1 for Nott'm Forest and they got 4, all in the second half while leading (time-wasting and tactical fouls). Man City were predicted 1.6 and got 0. Referee Barrott's low card rate did not outweigh a leading side wasting time after the break.
16363919.lesson_en: When a counter-attacking home side faces a possession-heavy favourite, don't cut the home win chance just because of a home scoring drought and low xG; if the home side scores early, expect clearly more cards for the leading team and more corners for the trailing one.

16363920.verdict: 結果判斷錯了：看好 Chelsea（44%），實際主隊 1-0 獲勝，而且 Sunderland 的 xG 2.55 對 0.53 遠勝對手，這不是運氣。
points: Chelsea 控球 69%，卻只有 0.53 xG；賽前已經看到 Chelsea 多名主力缺陣、門將換成 Penders，但客勝仍然給了 44%，下調不夠。
Sunderland 靠 Le Fée 第 36 分鐘的點球進球，之後打防守反擊，xG 2.55 說明主隊機會質量更高。
全場黃牌 9 張（5-4），雖然因為 Jarred Gillett 給牌多已經上調，但仍明顯低於實際；Sunderland 犯規 17 次也遠超預測。
雙方角球只有 2-2，遠低於預測的 4.6-5.4；Chelsea 空有控球，傳不進禁區。
16363920.lesson: When a big club has many key absences plus a keeper change and the market is drifting, shift the 1X2 more toward the home win or draw rather than just switching the top scoreline to 1-1.
16363920.verdict_en: Wrong result: we leaned Chelsea (44%) but the hosts won 1-0, and Sunderland's 2.55 vs 0.53 xG shows it was no fluke.
points_en: Chelsea had 69% possession but only 0.53 xG; we already knew several first-team players were out and Penders was in goal, yet still gave the away win 44%, which was not a big enough cut.
Sunderland went ahead through Le Fée's 36th-minute penalty and then played on the counter; their 2.55 xG shows they had the better chances.
There were 9 yellow cards in total (5-4); we had already raised cards because Jarred Gillett books a lot, but still came in well short, and Sunderland's 17 fouls were far above the forecast.
Corners were only 2-2, far below the predicted 4.6-5.4; Chelsea's possession never turned into entries into the box.
16363920.lesson_en: When a big club has many key absences plus a keeper change and the market is drifting, shift the 1X2 more toward the home win or draw rather than just switching the top scoreline to 1-1.

16363654.verdict: Aston Villa 控球 71% 壓制對手，但只有 0.39 xG，0-0 符合賽前半場預測。
points: 半場 0-0 預測正確；Aston Villa 射門 8 比 2，可是只有 2 腳射正，進攻效率低，和賽前判斷一致。
角球 5 比 0，比預期的 2.3 比 2.0 更一面倒；Sunderland 缺少 Xhaka 和 Brobbey，幾乎沒辦法把球推進到前場。
犯規 10 比 10，遠高於預期的 5.0 比 6.6；裁判 Madley 上半場只出示 1 張黃牌（Hume），黃牌數暫時比預期少。
16363654.headline: Aston Villa 會繼續圍攻，但進攻缺乏威脅，Sunderland 有機會守住平局。
16363654.changes: 主勝從 55% 降到 44%，平局從 24% 升到 41%，因為只剩 45 分鐘而且 Aston Villa 的 xG 很低；全場角球大幅改成 9.5 比 2.0；犯規按上半場的節奏調高到 18.5 比 19.5；黃牌略降。
16363654.verdict_en: Aston Villa dominated with 71% possession but created only 0.39 xG; 0-0 matched the predicted half-time score.
points_en: The 0-0 HT call was right; Villa had 8 shots to 2 but only 2 on target, as inefficient as expected.
Corners 5-0 were even more one-sided than the predicted 2.3-2.0; without Xhaka and Brobbey, Sunderland could barely get the ball forward.
Fouls were 10-10, far above the predicted 5.0-6.6; Madley showed only one yellow (Hume), so cards are running below forecast.
16363654.headline_en: Villa will keep pushing, but their attack lacks bite and Sunderland can hold out for a draw.
16363654.changes_en: Home win cut from 55% to 44% and draw raised from 24% to 41%, since only 45 minutes remain and Villa's xG is low; full-time corners raised sharply to 9.5-2.0; fouls raised to 18.5-19.5 to match the first-half pace; cards slightly lowered.

16363655.verdict: Bournemouth 創造 4 次絕佳機會、xG 1.97，半場 2-0 領先，遠超賽前預測的半場 0-0。
points: 半場比分預測錯誤：Bournemouth 上半場 5 腳射正打進 2 球（Evanilson 19 分鐘、Kluivert 45 分鐘），Nott'm Forest 一腳射正都沒有。
上半場進球預期只有 0.7 比 0.35，但 Bournemouth 實際 xG 1.97，錯在低估了他們近期的進攻狀態。
角球 4 比 1、犯規 4 比 7、黃牌 0 比 1（Delap），大致接近預測。
16363655.headline: Nott'm Forest 必須壓上，Bournemouth 可以打反擊，很有機會再進球。
16363655.changes: 主勝從 51% 升到 93.8%；最可能比分從 1-0 改成 2-0、3-0；大 2.5 球從 47% 升到 69.9%；Nott'm Forest 落後要壓上，所以客隊角球和主隊犯規都調高。
16363655.verdict_en: Bournemouth created 4 big chances (1.97 xG) and lead 2-0 at the break, well beyond the predicted 0-0 HT.
points_en: The HT score call was wrong: Bournemouth scored twice from 5 shots on target (Evanilson 19', Kluivert 45'), while Forest did not have a single shot on target.
We expected only 0.7-0.35 first-half goals; Bournemouth's actual 1.97 xG shows we underrated their current attacking form.
Corners 4-1, fouls 4-7 and cards 0-1 (Delap) were roughly in line with the forecast.
16363655.headline_en: Forest must push forward, leaving space for Bournemouth to counter and add more goals.
16363655.changes_en: Home win raised from 51% to 93.8%; most likely scores changed from 1-0 to 2-0 and 3-0; Over 2.5 raised from 47% to 69.9%; Forest corners and Bournemouth fouls raised because Forest will chase the game.

16363656.verdict: Brentford 完全壓制上半場，23 分鐘到 25 分鐘之間連進兩球，Everton 40 分鐘又被罰下 Tarkowski，賽前預測的半場 0-0 明顯錯了。
points: 半場比分和進球都猜錯：預測 0-0，上半進球主 0.6、客 0.4；實際 Lewis-Potter 3 分鐘內梅開二度，打成 2-0。Brentford 控球 65%，射門 13 比 3，xG 1.15 比 0.15。賽前說市場看好 Everton，結果相反，Thiago 停賽也沒有影響 Brentford 的進攻。
角球和黃牌接近預測：角球 3 比 3（預測 2.6 比 2.0，Everton 多了一點）；黃牌 0 比 1（預測 0.6 比 0.7）。Mykolenko 在 Everton 失第二球之後吃到黃牌。
犯規方向反了：預測 Brentford 犯規較多（5.6 比 4.6），實際 4 比 6。原因是 Everton 一直處於被動、要追著搶球，最後 Tarkowski 經 VAR 從黃牌升級為紅牌，少一人比賽，整個走勢已經偏向主隊。
16363656.headline: Brentford 領先兩球又多一人，下半場可以控制節奏；Everton 很難組織反撲，主隊再進一球的機會較大。
16363656.changes: 勝平負從 40/29/31 改為 95/4/1，最可能比分從 1-1 改為 3-0。主隊角球和 Everton 犯規上調：Brentford 多一人會持續壓制，Everton 被迫多犯規。Everton 黃牌升到 2.0，Brentford 黃牌降到 0.9，因為主隊領先後不需要冒險。大 2.5 球只差一球，所以給 70%。
16363656.verdict_en: Brentford dominated the first half, scoring twice between the 23rd and 25th minute, and Everton lost Tarkowski to a red card on 40'. The 0-0 half-time prediction was clearly wrong.
points_en: Half-time score and goals were wrong: we predicted 0-0, with first-half goals of 0.6 for the home side and 0.4 for the away side. Lewis-Potter scored twice in 3 minutes for a 2-0 lead. Brentford had 65% possession, 13 shots to 3 and xG of 1.15 to 0.15. The market had been backing Everton, but the match went the other way, and Thiago's suspension did not hold Brentford's attack back.

Corners and yellow cards were close to the prediction: corners finished 3-3 (predicted 2.6-2.0, so Everton had slightly more than expected), and yellow cards 0-1 (predicted 0.6-0.7). Mykolenko was booked just after Everton conceded the second goal.

Fouls went the opposite way: we expected Brentford to commit more (5.6 vs 4.6), but it was 4-6. Everton spent the half chasing the ball, and Tarkowski's card was upgraded from yellow to red after a VAR review, so the game now tilts heavily towards the home side.
16363656.headline_en: Two goals up and a man up, Brentford can control the tempo in the second half. Everton will struggle to mount a comeback, and another home goal is the more likely outcome.
16363656.changes_en: 1X2 moves from 40/29/31 to 95/4/1, and the most likely score from 1-1 to 3-0. Home corners and Everton fouls are raised: with an extra man Brentford will keep pressing, and Everton will be forced into more fouls. Everton yellow cards rise to 2.0 and Brentford's drop to 0.9, because the home side has no need to take risks while leading. Over 2.5 needs only one more goal, so it is set at 70%.

16363657.verdict: 上半場踢成 1-1，比賽很開放，Leeds 的機會品質更好（xG 0.37 對 0.2，絕佳機會 2 對 0），Chelsea 表現不如賽前預期。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0 沒有猜中：25' Emegha 先進球，3 分鐘後 Okafor 扳平。上半場進球預期 0.65/0.4，實際兩隊各進 1 球，都比預期多；Chelsea 的進球效率高於 xG。
角球明顯估高：預測 2.5/2.0，實際只有 0/1。Chelsea 雖有 50% 控球，但很少打到邊路深處。22' 的傷病換人也打亂了 Chelsea 的節奏。
犯規和黃牌方向正確：Leeds 犯規 7 次（預測 6.6），還吃到一張黃牌（Gudmundsson）；Chelsea 只犯規 2 次，比預測的 4.7 低很多。Leeds 越位 5 次，說明他們一直在打身後空檔，很有威脅。
16363657.headline: 下半場 Chelsea 在主場會加強進攻，但 Leeds 的反擊和打身後更有威脅；平局可能性最高，主隊稍佔優勢。
16363657.changes: 主勝從 46% 降到 33%，平局從 28% 升到 41%，客勝維持 26%。原因是比分已是 1-1，而 Leeds 上半場的機會品質更好。最可能比分維持 1-1；雙方都進球已經成立（100%）。全場角球從 5.2/4.3 大幅下調到 3.0/3.0，因為上半場角球很少。Chelsea 犯規下調到 7.0，Leeds 犯規和黃牌維持偏高。
16363657.verdict_en: 1-1 at half-time in an open game; Leeds created the better chances (xG 0.37 vs 0.2, big chances 2-0) and Chelsea underperformed expectations.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time call was wrong: Emegha scored on 25' and Okafor equalised three minutes later. Both sides beat the expected first-half goals (0.65/0.4); Chelsea finished above their xG.
Corners were clearly overestimated: 2.5/2.0 predicted, 0/1 actual. Chelsea had 50% possession but rarely got deep on the flanks, and the 22' injury substitution disrupted their rhythm.

Fouls and cards went the predicted way: Leeds committed 7 fouls (6.6 predicted) and took a yellow (Gudmundsson). Chelsea committed only 2, well below the predicted 4.7. Leeds' 5 offsides show they kept attacking the space behind.
16363657.headline_en: Chelsea will push harder at home in the second half, but Leeds' counters and runs in behind look more dangerous; a draw is the most likely result, with Chelsea slightly favoured.
16363657.changes_en: Home win cut from 46% to 33%, draw up from 28% to 41%, away win unchanged at 26%. The score is already 1-1 and Leeds had the better first-half chances. Most likely score stays 1-1; both teams to score is already settled (100%). Full-time corners cut sharply from 5.2/4.3 to 3.0/3.0 after a quiet first half for corners. Chelsea fouls lowered to 7.0; Leeds fouls and cards stay high.

16363658.verdict: 雙方後防都很差，上半場就打出 2-2，賽前「兩隊後防不穩」的判斷應驗，但進球數遠超預測。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0 錯誤：4 腳射正換來 4 個進球，兩隊的門將和後防都有失誤，Coventry 缺了 Yirenkyi，Crystal Palace 本季也一直在丟球。
Crystal Palace 控球 62%、絕佳機會 5 比 2，換中鋒後 Larsen 補時進球，說明市場轉向 Crystal Palace 有道理。
角球只有 1 比 1，遠低於預期；犯規 5 比 8、黃牌 0 比 1（Wharton），接近預測。
16363658.headline: 比賽很開放，Crystal Palace 的機會品質較高，下半場勝負很難預料。
16363658.changes: 大 2.5 球和雙方進球都已經成立（100%）；主勝從 38% 降到 26.9%，平局升到 37.3%，客勝 35.8%；全場角球大幅下調到 3.5 比 4.5；Crystal Palace 犯規上調。
16363658.verdict_en: Both defences collapsed and it was 2-2 by half-time, confirming the shaky-defence read, but with far more goals than predicted.
points_en: The 0-0 HT call was wrong: 4 shots on target produced 4 goals, with keepers and defences at fault on both sides; Coventry were missing Yirenkyi and Palace have leaked goals all season.
Palace had 62% possession and 5 big chances to 2, and stand-in striker Larsen scored in stoppage time, so the market's move towards Palace looks justified.
Corners were only 1-1, far below the forecast; fouls 5-8 and cards 0-1 (Wharton) were close to it.
16363658.headline_en: An open game where Palace create the better chances; the second half could go either way.
16363658.changes_en: Over 2.5 and BTTS have already landed (100%); home win cut from 38% to 26.9%, draw raised to 37.3%, away win 35.8%; full-time corners cut sharply to 3.5-4.5; Palace fouls raised.

16363659.verdict: Brighton dominated the first half (xG 1.75 vs 0.2, 4 big chances) but did not score. The Hull City keeper's 5 saves kept it 0-0, so the half-time score we predicted was right, but only just.
points: 半場0-0和上半場角球（預測1.9對2.9，實際1對3）基本準確；上半場進球預期[0.4, 0.7]也大致吻合，但 Brighton 的 xG 達到1.75、有4次絕佳機會，沒有進球主要是 Hull City 門將撲出5球、Brighton 把握機會差，走勢比比分更一邊倒。
犯規方向猜反了：預測主隊犯規較多（5.3對4.6），實際 Hull City 只有3次，Brighton 卻有9次。Brighton 控球72%，丟球後即時反搶、阻止 Hull City 反擊，所以犯規偏多；黃牌各1張，和預測的0.8對0.6接近。
Hull City 在45分鐘因傷換人，提前用掉一個換人名額，下半場體能和輪換會更吃緊；N. Mendy 和 L. Vušković 已經各有一張黃牌，下半場預料會收斂。
16363659.headline: 下半場 Brighton 預料繼續壓著 Hull City 打，客勝仍然最有可能；但只剩45分鐘，如果 Brighton 還是浪費機會，0-0或1-0小勝的機率不低。
16363659.changes: 客勝由59%降到52%，平局由24%升到35%，因為剩下的時間少了，0-0的機率大增；主勝降到13%，因為 Hull City 上半場只有0.2 xG，進攻幾乎沒有威脅。全場比分改為0-1、0-0、0-2。全場角球改為[2.8, 6.2]，客隊略多於賽前，因為 Brighton 壓制明顯。犯規由[12.0, 10.0]改為[8.5, 13.5]，因為 Brighton 的反搶犯規遠多於預期，Hull City 控球少、犯規也少。黃牌改為[2.1, 2.0]，主隊比賽前下調。
16363659.verdict_en: Brighton dominated the first half (xG 1.75 vs 0.2, 4 big chances) but did not score. The Hull City keeper's 5 saves kept it 0-0, so the half-time score we predicted was right, but only just.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score and the first-half corners (predicted 1.9 vs 2.9, actual 1 vs 3) were broadly correct. First-half expected goals of [0.4, 0.7] were roughly in line too, but Brighton reached 1.75 xG with 4 big chances. They failed to score mainly because the Hull City keeper made 5 saves and Brighton finished poorly, so the game was far more one-sided than the score.

We got the foul direction backwards: we expected the home side to foul more (5.3 vs 4.6), but Hull City committed only 3 and Brighton 9. With 72% possession, Brighton counter-pressed straight after losing the ball to stop Hull City breaking, which pushed their foul count up. Yellow cards were 1 each, close to the predicted 0.8 vs 0.6.

Hull City made an injury substitution at 45', using up a change early and leaving their fitness and rotation stretched for the second half. N. Mendy and L. Vušković are both on a yellow card and are likely to be more careful after the break.
16363659.headline_en: Brighton should keep pinning Hull City back in the second half, and an away win is still the most likely result. But with only 45 minutes left, there is a real chance of 0-0 or a narrow 1-0 if Brighton keep wasting chances.
16363659.changes_en: Away win cut from 59% to 52% and draw raised from 24% to 35%, because less time remains and 0-0 is now much more likely. Home win falls to 13%, since Hull City managed only 0.2 xG in the first half and posed almost no attacking threat. Full-time scores are now 0-1, 0-0, 0-2. Full-time corners moved to [2.8, 6.2], slightly more for the away side than before kickoff, given how clearly Brighton are on top. Fouls changed from [12.0, 10.0] to [8.5, 13.5], because Brighton's counter-press fouls are far above expectation and Hull City, with little of the ball, are fouling less. Yellow cards changed to [2.1, 2.0], lower for the home side than before kickoff.

16363660.verdict: Yoro 第 8 分鐘被紅牌罰下，比賽從此一面倒。Liverpool 在 5 分鐘內連進兩球，xG 1.67 比 0.14，半場 2-0 領先完全合理。
points: 賽前預測半場 0-0、上半場進球 0.8 比 0.5，兩項都錯。第 8 分鐘的紅牌是模型和 AI 都無法預見的突發事件。Szoboszlai 和 Wirtz 在第 10、13 分鐘相繼進球，之後 Liverpool 射門 12 比 4、射正 6 比 1，完全壓制對手。
上半場角球 6 比 3，遠高於預測的 2.5 比 2.1。少一人的 Man United 只能退守，Liverpool 長時間圍攻，角球大增。這也印證了已知的偏差：一隊主導比賽時，角球會被低估。
犯規 9 比 2，和預測的 6.5 比 5.0 方向相反。Liverpool 主動逼搶，犯規反而較多；Man United 很少持球，犯規很少。上半場沒有黃牌，只有一張紅牌，預測的上半場各 0.55 張黃牌沒有出現。
16363660.headline: Man United 少一人又落後兩球，下半場 Liverpool 大機率繼續控制比賽，可能再進一球。但 3 天後要踢歐冠，Liverpool 也可能放慢節奏、輪換保存體力。
16363660.changes: 主勝由 55.5% 提高到 98.1%。最可能比分由 2-1 改為 3-0，雙方都進球的機率降到約 30%。全場角球上調到 10.0 比 4.5，因為 Liverpool 持續壓制。主隊犯規上調到 15.0，客隊下調到 7.0，因為 Man United 少一人，持球時間很少。全場黃牌下調到 1.2 比 1.8，因為比賽懸念不大；Man United 防守時仍可能吃牌。
16363660.verdict_en: Yoro's 8th-minute red card made this one-sided. Liverpool scored twice in five minutes, and 2-0 at half-time is fully deserved on xG of 1.67 to 0.14.
points_en: The predicted 0-0 half-time and 0.8 vs 0.5 first-half goals were both wrong. The 8th-minute red card was a shock that neither the model nor the AI could foresee. Szoboszlai and Wirtz scored on 10' and 13', and Liverpool then dominated with 12 shots to 4 and 6 on target to 1.
First-half corners were 6-3, far above the predicted 2.5-2.1. Ten-man United sat deep and Liverpool besieged them, which fits the known bias: corners are underestimated when one side dominates.

Fouls were 9-2, the reverse of the predicted 6.5-5.0. Liverpool's pressing caused more fouls while United barely had the ball. There were no yellow cards, only the red, so the predicted 0.55 yellows each did not happen.
16363660.headline_en: United are down to ten men and two goals behind, so Liverpool should keep control after the break and may add another. With a Champions League game in three days, they could also slow the tempo and rotate to save energy.
16363660.changes_en: Home win raised from 55.5% to 98.1%. Most likely score moves from 2-1 to 3-0, and BTTS drops to about 30%. Full-time corners raised to 10.0-4.5 because Liverpool keep pressing. Liverpool's fouls raised to 15.0 and United's cut to 7.0, since ten-man United have very little of the ball. Full-time yellows cut to 1.2-1.8 because the game is largely decided, though United may still pick up cards while defending.

16363661.verdict: Man City 上半場壓著打，xG 1.63 對 0.44，但只有 2 腳射正，反而被 Fulham 在第 16 分鐘由 Muniz 進球，以 0-1 落後，和賽前預測的半場 1-0 剛好相反。
points: 比分和進球：賽前預測半場 1-0、上半進球 0.9 對 0.3，實際是 0-1。Man City 的 xG 1.63 比預期還高，Fulham 只有 2 腳射門，2 腳都射正，進了 1 球，效率極高；Man City 9 腳射門只有 2 腳射正，臨門一腳不夠準。
角球和犯規：角球預測 3.4 對 1.7，實際 5 對 2，Man City 壓制比預期更明顯。犯規預測 4.0 對 5.3，實際 5 對 7，大致準確。
黃牌：預測 Fulham 上半場 0.6 張，實際已經 3 張（Iwobi、Bassey、Charles）。即使裁判 Bramall 出牌偏少，Fulham 在高壓下也要不斷犯規，這部分預測明顯偏低；Bassey 和 Charles 都是後防球員，下半場有被罰下的風險。
16363661.headline: 下半場 Man City 會全力壓上，角球和射門會繼續增加；Fulham 會退守打反擊，3 張黃牌讓他們的後防必須收斂，一旦有人被罰下，形勢會大幅倒向 Man City。
16363661.changes: 主勝從 65% 降到 32%，客勝從 16% 升到 40%，因為 Man City 落後一球，至少要淨勝兩球才能贏。最可能比分從 2-1 改為 1-1。Man City 全場角球從 7.0 升到 9.5，因為落後方會持續壓上。Fulham 全場黃牌從 2.3 升到 4.1，因為上半場已經有 3 張。全場進球預期改為 1.4 對 1.5（含已進的球）。
16363661.verdict_en: Man City dominated the first half (xG 1.63 vs 0.44) but managed only 2 shots on target, and Fulham scored through Muniz on 16' to lead 0-1 at the break, the reverse of the predicted 1-0.
points_en: Score and goals: we predicted 1-0 at half-time with 1st-half goals of 0.9 vs 0.3; the actual score is 0-1. City's xG was even higher than expected, while Fulham's 2 shots were both on target and one went in, which is very efficient. City had 9 shots but only 2 on target.
Corners and fouls: corners were predicted 3.4 vs 1.7, actual 5 vs 2, so City's dominance was stronger than expected. Fouls were predicted 4.0 vs 5.3, actual 5 vs 7, roughly on target.

Yellow cards: Fulham were expected to get 0.6 in the 1st half but already have 3 (Iwobi, Bassey, Charles). Even with lenient referee Bramall, City's pressure forced constant fouling, so we under-predicted this. Bassey and Charles are both defenders and risk a red card in the second half.
16363661.headline_en: In the second half City will throw everything forward, so expect more corners and shots. Fulham will sit deep and counter, and 3 bookings force their defence to be careful. A red card would swing the game heavily towards City.
16363661.changes_en: Home win cut from 65% to 32% and away win raised from 16% to 40%, because City are a goal down and need to outscore Fulham by two to win. Most likely score changed from 2-1 to 1-1. City corners raised from 7.0 to 9.5 because the trailing side keeps attacking. Fulham yellows raised from 2.3 to 4.1 since they already have 3. Full-time expected goals are now 1.4 vs 1.5 (including the goal already scored).

16363662.verdict: Arsenal 上半場全面壓制，xG 1.38 對 0.08，Eze 的進球名正言順；賽前預測方向正確，但半場比分（0-0）和角球數都錯了。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0，實際 0-1。上半場進球預期 0.4 對 0.65 本身不算離譜，但 Arsenal 製造了 4 次絕佳機會、3 腳射正，效率高於模型預期；Newcastle 只射了 3 腳、無一射正，進攻幾乎沒有威脅。
角球明顯高估：預測 2.2 對 2.6，實際只有 0 對 1。Arsenal 控球 65%，多數從中路配合和禁區前的短傳打開缺口，沒有靠邊路傳中逼出角球；Newcastle 則很少推進到對方三十米區域。
犯規和黃牌大致符合：Newcastle 8 次犯規，高於預測的 6.4，被壓著打只能靠犯規斷節奏，Dedić 23 分鐘吃到黃牌；Arsenal 4 次犯規、0 張黃牌，接近預測的 4.9 和 0.45，裁判 Kavanagh 的尺度目前還算正常。
16363662.headline: Newcastle 下半場必須壓上，可能換上進攻型替補，角球和犯規都會增加；Arsenal 習慣小比分守住勝果，三天後還有歐冠，大概會收縮打反擊。最可能的結果是 0-1 或 0-2。
16363662.changes: Arsenal 勝率從 57% 提高到 75%，Newcastle 勝率從 19% 降到 6%，原因是已領先一球，而且上半場 xG 差距懸殊。最可能比分由 0-1、1-1、0-2 調整為 0-1、0-2、1-1。全場角球從 4.3 對 5.6 大幅下調到 2.6 對 2.8，因為上半場只有 1 個角球。犯規提高到 14.0 對 10.0，Newcastle 落後要追，犯規會更多。黃牌改為 2.3 對 1.4：Newcastle 已有一張，Dedić 下半場會收斂；Arsenal 後段拖延時間，也可能吃牌。
16363662.verdict_en: Arsenal dominated the first half (xG 1.38 vs 0.08) and Eze's goal was fully deserved. The pre-match call got the direction right but missed the 0-0 half-time score and overestimated corners.
