points_en: We predicted 0-0 at half-time; it was 0-1. Our first-half goal expectation of 0.4 vs 0.65 was not far off, but Arsenal created 4 big chances and put 3 shots on target, finishing better than the model expected. Newcastle had 3 shots and none on target, so they barely threatened.

Corners were clearly overestimated: we predicted 2.2 vs 2.6, but there were only 0 vs 1. With 65% possession, Arsenal mostly opened Newcastle up through central combinations and short passing around the box, not wide crosses that win corners. Newcastle rarely got into the final third.

Fouls and cards were roughly on track. Newcastle committed 8 fouls (we predicted 6.4) as they tried to break Arsenal's rhythm under pressure, and Dedić was booked in the 23rd minute. Arsenal had 4 fouls and 0 cards, close to the predicted 4.9 and 0.45. Referee Kavanagh has been fairly normal so far.
16363662.headline_en: Newcastle have to push forward in the second half and may bring on attacking subs, so corners and fouls should rise. Arsenal usually protect narrow leads and have a Champions League game in three days, so expect them to sit deeper and counter. 0-1 or 0-2 is the most likely finish.
16363662.changes_en: Arsenal's win chance goes up from 57% to 75% and Newcastle's drops from 19% to 6%, because Arsenal lead by one goal and the first-half xG gap was huge. Most likely scores change from 0-1, 1-1, 0-2 to 0-1, 0-2, 1-1. Full-time corners are cut sharply from 4.3 vs 5.6 to 2.6 vs 2.8 after a single first-half corner. Fouls go up to 14.0 vs 10.0 because Newcastle will foul more while chasing. Cards are now 2.3 vs 1.4: Newcastle already have one and Dedić will have to be careful, while Arsenal may pick up bookings for time-wasting late on.

16363663.verdict: Tottenham 如預期壓制對手，xG 1.63 比 0.13，但只進 1 球，半場 1-0 領先。
points: 半場 0-0 預測錯誤：Williams-Barnett 15 分鐘就進球，Tottenham 射正 7 次，比賽前預計的效率好。
Tottenham 控球 67%，射門 12 比 4，角球 5 比 2 也比預期的 3.5 比 1.4 多，一面倒的判斷正確。
犯規 6 比 7、黃牌 1 比 0（Maddison），和預測差不多。
16363663.headline: Tottenham 繼續控制比賽，大概率再進球鎖定勝局；Ipswich 只能靠反擊。
16363663.changes: 主勝從 60% 升到 84.8%；比分首選改為 1-0、2-0；Ipswich 落後要壓上，客隊角球從 3.0 升到 4.0，主隊角球升到 9.5；Ipswich 黃牌略降，大 2.5 球調整為 39.1%。
16363663.verdict_en: Tottenham dominated as expected (1.63 xG to 0.13) but converted only once, leading 1-0 at the break.
points_en: The 0-0 HT call was wrong: Williams-Barnett scored after 15 minutes and Tottenham had 7 shots on target, more clinical than we assumed.
67% possession, 12 shots to 4 and corners 5-2 (vs a predicted 3.5-1.4) confirm the one-sided read.
Fouls 6-7 and cards 1-0 (Maddison) were close to the forecast.
16363663.headline_en: Tottenham should keep control and likely add a goal to seal it; Ipswich can only hope to counter.
16363663.changes_en: Home win raised from 60% to 84.8%; top scores now 1-0 and 2-0; with Ipswich chasing, away corners raised from 3.0 to 4.0 and home corners to 9.5; Ipswich cards slightly lowered; Over 2.5 set at 39.1%.

16363901.verdict: 維拉上半場機會質素較高（xG 1.2 對 0.6），N. Jackson 39 分鐘進球領先；賽前預測半場 0-0 不中，但進球總數和犯規總數都大致接近。
points: 半場比分：預測 0-0，實際 1-0。維拉 xG 1.2、大好機會 2 次，13 分鐘 Goretzka 一次被 VAR 判不給的點球已經反映維拉在禁區內有威脅，領先合理。上半場進球預測 [0.6, 0.4]，實際 [1, 0]，大致接近。
角球：預測 [2.2, 2.9]，實際 [5, 2]。富勒姆控球較多（53%），但維拉進攻更直接，射門和角球都較多，賽前低估了維拉的角球，富勒姆則被高估。
犯規和黃牌：上半場犯規總數預測約 10.6，實際 10，總數準確，但分佈完全偏向富勒姆（2 對 8），黃牌 0 對 2（Affengruber、Bassey）。富勒姆被迫用犯規阻截維拉的反擊，裁判 Samuel Barrott 尺度偏嚴，這點與賽前判斷吻合。
16363901.headline: 下半場富勒姆要壓上追和，角球會增加；維拉可以退守打反擊，最可能守住 1-0，或者再入一球擴大領先。
16363901.changes: 主勝由 47% 升至 68%，客勝由 27% 跌至 11%，原因是維拉領先 1-0 而且 xG 佔優。最可能比分由 1-1 改為 1-0、2-0。全場角球由 [4.2, 5.6] 改為 [7.5, 5.5]：維拉上半場已有 5 個，下半場富勒姆壓上會追回一些。犯規由 [10.5, 12.0] 改為 [7.5, 13.0]：富勒姆上半場已犯規 8 次，維拉下半場守領先會多一點犯規。黃牌由 [2.0, 2.3] 改為 [1.2, 2.9]：富勒姆已有 2 張，兩名已吃黃牌的球員會收斂，但裁判尺度嚴，富勒姆追分時仍會再吃牌；維拉守領先和拖延時間，也可能吃牌。大 2.5 球約 42.5%，需要下半場再入兩球。
16363901.verdict_en: Villa created the better chances in the first half (xG 1.2 vs 0.6) and lead through N. Jackson's 39th-minute goal. The predicted 0-0 half-time score missed, but total goals and total fouls were roughly right.
points_en: Half-time score: predicted 0-0, actual 1-0. Villa had xG 1.2 and 2 big chances, and the VAR check on a possible Goretzka penalty in the 13th minute already showed their threat in the box. The lead is deserved. First-half goals were predicted at [0.6, 0.4] vs actual [1, 0], which is close.

Corners: predicted [2.2, 2.9], actual [5, 2]. Fulham had more of the ball (53%), but Villa attacked more directly and had more shots and corners. Villa's corners were underestimated and Fulham's overestimated.

Fouls and cards: total first-half fouls were predicted at about 10.6 and came in at 10, so the total was right, but the split was heavily one-sided (2 vs 8) and yellow cards went 0-2 (Affengruber, Bassey). Fulham had to foul to stop Villa's counters, and referee Samuel Barrott is strict, which matches the pre-match view.
16363901.headline_en: In the second half Fulham must push forward to equalise, so they will win more corners. Villa can sit back and counter; the most likely outcome is that they hold 1-0 or add a second goal.
16363901.changes_en: Home win raised from 47% to 68% and away win cut from 27% to 11%, because Villa lead 1-0 with the better xG. Most likely score changed from 1-1 to 1-0 or 2-0. Full-time corners changed from [4.2, 5.6] to [7.5, 5.5]: Villa already have 5, and Fulham will catch up some as they push. Fouls changed from [10.5, 12.0] to [7.5, 13.0]: Fulham already have 8, and Villa will foul a bit more while protecting the lead. Cards changed from [2.0, 2.3] to [1.2, 2.9]: Fulham already have 2, and their two booked players will be careful, but with a strict referee Fulham will probably pick up more cards as they chase the game; Villa may also be booked while defending and wasting time. Over 2.5 goals is about 42.5%, as it needs two more goals in the second half.

16363902.verdict: 伯恩茅斯憑 Evanilson 31分鐘進球領先，上半場大致符合「主隊稍佔優」的預期，但半場比分預測0-0落空。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，主隊xG 0.63對0.41，進球期望值（0.65/0.4）與實際走勢相當接近
11分鐘利茲聯 Calvert-Lewin 有一次VAR判決，但比分仍是1-0，以比分為準；利茲聯控球53%，射門卻只得3次，威脅有限
犯規7對10，比預測多，主要是利茲聯偏多；黃牌1對1，與預測吻合，角球2對1略低於預測
16363902.headline: 利茲聯落後要壓上，伯恩茅斯可以打反擊再添一球，主隊守住勝果的機會較大。
16363902.changes: 賽前主勝44%，現在升到62%，因為主隊已經領先；利茲聯上半場犯規已有10次，所以全場犯規上調；大2.5球機率下調，因為還要再入兩球。
16363902.verdict_en: Bournemouth lead through Evanilson's 31st-minute goal, roughly matching the 'home slight edge' view, but the 0-0 HT call missed.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; xG 0.63 vs 0.41 was close to the expected 1H goals (0.65/0.4)
Leeds had a VAR moment with Calvert-Lewin on 11', but the score stands 1-0; Leeds had 53% possession but only 3 shots
Fouls 7 vs 10, above forecast, mostly from Leeds; yellows 1-1 as expected; corners 2-1 slightly under
16363902.headline_en: Leeds must push; Bournemouth can counter for a second and are favourites to hold on.
16363902.changes_en: Home win up from 44% to 62% after taking the lead; full-time fouls raised because Leeds already have 10; over 2.5 lowered since two more goals are needed.

16363903.verdict: 布倫特福德靠 Milenković 的烏龍球領先，但上半場是森林佔優，主隊xG只有0.15。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，進球來自烏龍球，不是布倫特福德打出來的機會
森林射門9對4，xG 0.41對0.15，符合賽前「森林運氣差多於實力差」的判斷
犯規只有3對7，遠低於預測的6.3/6.4；Milenković 烏龍之後再吃黃牌，角球2對2接近預測
16363903.headline: 森林追分會壓上，扳平機會不小；布倫特福德主要靠反擊和定位球。
16363903.changes: 主勝從46%升到55%，因為已經領先，但森林場面較好，所以沒有升太多；布倫特福德犯規少，全場犯規預測下調；森林角球上調。
16363903.verdict_en: Brentford lead via a Milenković own goal, but Forest were better; Brentford's xG was just 0.15.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; the goal was an own goal, not a Brentford chance
Forest outshot them 9-4 (xG 0.41 vs 0.15), consistent with the 'unlucky, not bad' pre-match view
Fouls only 3 vs 7, far below the 6.3/6.4 forecast; Milenković booked after his own goal; corners 2-2 near forecast
16363903.headline_en: Forest will push and have a real chance to equalise; Brentford rely on counters and set pieces.
16363903.changes_en: Home win up from 46% to 55% only, given Forest's edge in play; Brentford fouls lowered; Forest corners raised.

16363904.verdict: 上半場曼聯明顯較有威脅，xG 1.01 對 0.28、絕佳機會 3 對 1，但比分仍是 0-0；半場比分預測命中，進球、角球和黃牌部分則有偏差。
points: 半場 0-0 預測命中。不過賽前預計上半場切爾西進球 0.7 球、曼聯 0.5 球，實際走勢相反：曼聯 9 次射門、3 次絕佳機會，xG 1.01；切爾西沒有正選中鋒，xG 只有 0.28，印證了賽前對其進球效率的擔心。34 分鐘 Cunha 有一次 VAR 判決事件，數據標示為「進球有效」，但提供的半場比分仍是 0-0，兩者有矛盾，本檢討按 0-0 處理。
角球低估了曼聯：實際 3 比 6，預測是 2.5 比 2.1。正如已知偏差，一方佔優勢時角球容易被低估，雖然控球率接近五五波，但曼聯的進攻次數明顯較多。
犯規分佈預測錯：實際 3 比 8，曼聯犯規遠多於預測的 5.6，切爾西則少於 5.3。兩隊合共 11 次，與預測總數 10.9 接近。數據中沒有黃牌紀錄，所以預計 1.9 張黃牌偏高；Bankes 上半場比預期寬鬆。
16363904.headline: 下半場只剩 45 分鐘，切爾西前線欠缺破門手段，曼聯憑反擊和機會質素稍佔上風；小球和和局機會最大，若有進球，曼聯先入的機會較高。
16363904.changes: 賽前切爾西勝平負為 44/26/30，現改為 24/38/38。原因：半場 0-0 只剩半場時間，和局機率大增；上半場 xG 及絕佳機會都是曼聯佔優，切爾西又沒有中鋒，所以把主勝大幅調低。最可能比分由 1-1 改為 0-0 / 0-1。全場角球由 5.2 比 4.6 改為 6.0 比 8.5，因曼聯上半場已有 6 個。全場犯規由 11.0 比 11.8 改為 8.5 比 13.5，按上半場的犯規分佈調整。上半場沒有黃牌，全場黃牌由約 5 張調低至約 3 張，但 Bankes 一向執法嚴厲，下半場膠著時仍可能多出牌。
16363904.verdict_en: Manchester United were clearly more threatening in the first half (xG 1.01 vs 0.28, big chances 3 vs 1), yet it is 0-0. The half-time score prediction was right, but the goal, corner and card details were off.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time call was correct. However, we expected Chelsea to create more (0.7 vs 0.5 first-half goals), and the opposite happened: United had 9 shots, 3 big chances and 1.01 xG. Chelsea, without a recognised striker, managed only 0.28 xG, confirming the pre-match worry about their finishing. There was a VAR incident involving Cunha on 34' that the data labels 'goal awarded', but the half-time score given is still 0-0. The two conflict, and this review treats the score as 0-0.

Corners underrated United: 3-6 actual vs 2.5-2.1 predicted. This matches the known bias that corners get underestimated when one side dominates. Possession was roughly even, but United attacked far more often.

The foul split was wrong: 3-8 actual. United fouled much more than the predicted 5.6 and Chelsea less than 5.3, although the combined total of 11 was close to the predicted 10.9. No yellow cards are recorded, so the forecast of about 1.9 was too high; Bankes was more lenient than expected.
16363904.headline_en: With 45 minutes left, Chelsea lack a cutting edge up front, while United's counter-attacks and better chances give them a slight edge. A low-scoring game or a draw is most likely; if anyone scores, United are more likely to get the first goal.
16363904.changes_en: The Chelsea win/draw/United win split moved from 44/26/30 to 24/38/38. Reason: at 0-0 with only half the game left, a draw becomes much more likely, and United led on xG and big chances while Chelsea have no striker, so the home-win chance was cut sharply. The most likely score changed from 1-1 to 0-0 / 0-1. Full-time corners changed from 5.2-4.6 to 6.0-8.5 because United already have 6. Full-time fouls changed from 11.0-11.8 to 8.5-13.5 to follow the first-half split. With no yellows in the first half, the card total drops from about 5 to about 3, though Bankes is usually strict and could still book more players in a tight second half.

16363905.verdict: 考文垂上半場兩球領先，賽前看好桑德蘭的判斷明顯錯了。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，Sakamoto 17分鐘、Awoniyi 37分鐘進球，xG只有0.39，射門把握很高
桑德蘭控球53%，xG卻只有0.29，只有1腳射正，進攻疲弱
犯規7對5，接近預測；考文垂 Torp 早段黃牌，角球3對1，比預測更偏向主隊
16363905.headline: 桑德蘭要壓上搶分，考文垂可以退守反擊，兩球優勢應該守得住。
16363905.changes: 賽前客勝38%最高，現在主勝升到80%；全場大2.5球大幅上調，因為只差一球；桑德蘭落後要壓上，角球上調。
16363905.verdict_en: Coventry lead 2-0 at the break; the pre-match lean towards Sunderland was clearly wrong.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; Sakamoto (17') and Awoniyi (37') scored from only 0.39 xG, very clinical finishing
Sunderland had 53% possession but just 0.29 xG and 1 shot on target
Fouls 7 vs 5 near forecast; Torp booked early; corners 3-1, more home-leaning than forecast
16363905.headline_en: Sunderland must chase; Coventry can sit deep and counter, and should hold a two-goal lead.
16363905.changes_en: Away win was the pre-match favourite at 38%; now home win is 80%; over 2.5 raised sharply since one more goal does it; Sunderland corners raised as they chase.

16363906.verdict: 伊普斯維奇控球69%，壓制赫爾城，F. Luís 22分鐘進球領先。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，伊普斯維奇控球和大機會（2對0）都佔上風，赫爾城沒有射正
赫爾城如賽前所料排低位防守，但沒能守住0-0，xG只有0.17
角球3對3，比預測略高；犯規6對5，接近預測；黃牌是客隊 Palacios 吃，不是預測偏多的赫爾城
16363906.headline: 赫爾城落後要打開陣型，伊普斯維奇會有更多反擊空間，但他們防守常有漏洞，赫爾城仍有扳平機會。
16363906.changes: 客勝從37%升到58%，因為伊普斯維奇已經領先，而且控制大局；赫爾城追分要壓上，角球上調；赫爾城黃牌比賽前預測少。
16363906.verdict_en: Ipswich dominated with 69% possession and lead through F. Luís on 22'.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; Ipswich led on possession and big chances (2-0), Hull had no shot on target
Hull sat deep as expected but couldn't hold 0-0; xG just 0.17
Corners 3-3, slightly above forecast; fouls 6-5 near forecast; the yellow went to Ipswich's Palacios, not card-prone Hull
16363906.headline_en: Hull must open up, leaving Ipswich more counter space, but Ipswich's leaky defence keeps an equaliser possible.
16363906.changes_en: Away win up from 37% to 58% with Ipswich ahead and in control; Hull corners raised as they chase; Hull cards lowered.

16363907.verdict: 利物浦控球和角球占優，但射正只有 1 次；阿森納靠 Havertz 第 16 分鐘的進球帶著 1-0 進入半場，賽前預測的方向是對的，半場比分沒有猜中。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0 沒有猜中，不過上半場總進球預測約 1 球，和實際的 1 球相符；xG 0.59 比 0.77，阿森納的機會品質略好，領先是合理的。
角球偏差最大：預測 2.4 比 2.7，實際 6 比 1。阿森納早早領先後退守，利物浦長時間在對方半場傳中，正好是模型已知的弱點：一方壓制時會低估角球。
犯規 5 比 6，比預測的 7.6 比 5.0 少，利物浦比較少犯規；黃牌 1 比 0 和預測的 0.6 比 0.4 接近，是 Barcola 在第 45 分鐘吃到的。
16363907.headline: 下半場利物浦會全力壓上，角球和傳中會繼續增加；阿森納有機會打反擊擴大比分，但利物浦扳平的機率大約五成多。
16363907.changes: 賽前是勝平負 31/28/41、最可能比分 1-1；現在阿森納領先，客勝提高到 61%，最可能比分改成 0-1。全場角球從 4.9 比 5.3 改成 10.0 比 3.0，因為利物浦落後要持續壓制。犯規改成 11 比 13，阿森納下半場防守和拖延時間會多犯規。黃牌改成 2.0 比 1.5：裁判 Madley 本季場均 4 張，阿森納下半場拖延時間容易吃牌，Barcola 已有一張黃牌會收斂。
16363907.verdict_en: Liverpool had more of the ball and the corners, but only 1 shot on target; Arsenal lead 1-0 at half-time through Havertz (16'). The pre-match lean towards Arsenal was right, the 0-0 half-time call was not.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score was wrong, but the predicted ~1 first-half goal matched. xG was 0.59 vs 0.77, so Arsenal's chances were slightly better and the lead is deserved.

Corners were the biggest miss: predicted 2.4 vs 2.7, actual 6 vs 1. After the early goal Arsenal sat deep while Liverpool kept crossing. This is the model's known blind spot: it underestimates corners when one side dominates.
Fouls were 5 vs 6, lower than the predicted 7.6 vs 5.0 (Liverpool fouled less than expected). Cards at 1-0 were close to the predicted 0.6 vs 0.4; Barcola was booked in the 45th minute.
16363907.headline_en: Liverpool will push hard in the second half, so expect more corners and crosses. Arsenal can hit them on the break, but Liverpool have a bit better than a 50% chance of scoring at least once.
16363907.changes_en: Pre-match was 31/28/41 with 1-1 the likeliest score. With Arsenal ahead, the away win rises to 61% and 0-1 is now the likeliest score. FT corners go from 4.9 vs 5.3 to 10.0 vs 3.0 because Liverpool will keep pressing while behind. Fouls are now 11 vs 13, as Arsenal defending and wasting time leads to more fouls. Cards are now 2.0 vs 1.5: Madley averages 4 cards a game this season, Arsenal time-wasting tends to draw bookings, and Barcola, already on a yellow, will hold back.

16363908.verdict: 布萊頓 Ayari 11分鐘進球，客隊領先；曼城控球55%但只有1腳射正，賽前預測半場1-0主隊領先錯了。
points: 半場比分預測1-0錯，xG 0.55對0.58，曼城預測上半進球0.9是高估了
曼城射門7對3，但布萊頓大機會2對1，反擊更有效率
角球3對1、犯規3對6，方向與預測一致；布萊頓 C. Andrés 已有黃牌，下半場要收斂
16363908.headline: 曼城會全力壓上，Haaland 和 Doku 會有更多機會，布萊頓要頂住壓力，再找反擊機會。
16363908.changes: 主勝從55%降到26%，客勝升到46%，因為布萊頓領先而且機會質素不差；曼城追分壓上，角球上調到8.5；布萊頓要拖延和防守，犯規和黃牌偏多。
16363908.verdict_en: Brighton lead through Ayari on 11'; City had 55% possession but one shot on target, so the 1-0 home HT call was wrong.
points_en: 1-0 HT call wrong; xG 0.55 vs 0.58, City's 0.9 expected 1H goals was too high
City outshot them 7-3, but Brighton had more big chances (2-1) and were more efficient on the break
Corners 3-1 and fouls 3-6 match the forecast direction; C. Andrés is on a yellow and must be careful
16363908.headline_en: City will throw everything forward with Haaland and Doku; Brighton must absorb pressure and hit on the break.
16363908.changes_en: Home win cut from 55% to 26%, away win up to 46% with Brighton ahead and creating good chances; City corners raised to 8.5 as they chase; Brighton fouls and cards stay high as they defend and slow the game.

16363909.verdict: 半場 0-0 和賽前預測一致，但 Everton 在場面上明顯佔優（xG 0.92 對 0.21、射門 10 對 5），Newcastle 主場依然打不出威脅。
points: 半場比分 0-0 預測正確：預測的上半場進球期望是 0.6 對 0.4，雙方都沒有進球，符合 Everton 作客上半場很少進球的趨勢；不過 Everton 有 1 次絕佳機會沒有把握住，差點被打破。
角球偏差：預測 3.0 對 2.4，實際 2 對 0。控球各 50%，Everton 主要靠射門製造威脅，沒有轉化成角球，所以客隊角球被高估。
犯規和黃牌：犯規 7 對 7，比預測的 5.8 對 5.0 高，賽前預期「剛交手過的火氣」確實出現；黃牌只有 Burn 32 分鐘的 1 張，裁判 John Brooks 上半場尺度比他的場均寬鬆。
16363909.headline: 下半場進球通常會比較多，但兩隊整體效率偏低；Everton 機會品質較好，Newcastle 主場需要主動壓上，角球可能向主隊傾斜。
16363909.changes: 勝平負由 41/27/32 改為 29/39/32：半場 0-0，只剩 45 分鐘，平局機率大幅上升；Newcastle 上半場 xG 只有 0.21，主勝機率下調。最可能比分由 1-1 改為 0-0。全場角球由 5.9/4.9 改為 5.0/2.8，因為 Everton 上半場 0 個角球，下半場 Newcastle 需要追分。犯規由 12/10 上調到 13.5/13，因為上半場已有 7/7。黃牌由 2.6/2.5 下調到 2.2/2.0，因為上半場只出現 1 張，Burn 吃牌後也會收斂。
16363909.verdict_en: 0-0 at half-time as predicted, but Everton were clearly better (xG 0.92 vs 0.21, shots 10 vs 5) while Newcastle again created little at home.
points_en: HT 0-0 correct: expected 1H goals were 0.6 vs 0.4 and neither side scored, matching Everton's low-scoring first halves away, although Everton missed one big chance.
Corners were off: predicted 3.0 vs 2.4, actual 2 vs 0. With possession at 50-50, Everton's threat came from shots rather than corners, so the away corner number was too high.

Fouls 7 vs 7 were above the 5.8 vs 5.0 forecast, so the expected tension from the recent cup meeting showed up. There was only 1 yellow (Burn, 32'), and John Brooks was more lenient than his season average.
16363909.headline_en: Second halves usually bring more goals, but both sides have been inefficient. Everton have the better chances, and Newcastle must push at home, which should tilt corners their way.
16363909.changes_en: 1X2 moved from 41/27/32 to 29/39/32: at 0-0 with 45 minutes left the draw is much more likely, and Newcastle's 0.21 1H xG cuts the home win. Most likely score changed from 1-1 to 0-0. Corners went from 5.9/4.9 to 5.0/2.8 because Everton had 0 in the 1H and Newcastle will push. Fouls went up from 12/10 to 13.5/13 after 7/7 at HT. Cards went down from 2.6/2.5 to 2.2/2.0 because there was only 1 in the 1H and Burn will be careful on a yellow.

16363910.verdict: Mateta 13 分鐘被 VAR 改判紅牌後，水晶宮只剩十人，熱刺全面壓制，上半場 1-0 領先完全合理。
points: 半場比分預測錯誤：賽前估 0-0。主要原因是 Mateta 早段被逐離場，熱刺之後控球 78%，第 25 分鐘由 A. Gray 進球。熱刺上半場預計入 0.75 球，實際入 1 球，算是接近；水晶宮預計入 0.35 球，實際 0 球，xG 只有 0.04。
角球方向正確，但數量低估：預測 3.0 比 1.7，實際 6 比 0。賽前已指出熱刺會控球多、角球大幅領先，紅牌令這個差距再擴大，與「一方壓制時模型會低估角球」的已知偏差一致。
犯規及紙牌：犯規預測 6.0 比 5.6，實際 5 比 7，大致準確，十人應戰的水晶宮要靠犯規阻截。黃牌方面熱刺 1 張（A. Gray），水晶宮 0 黃 1 紅；模型無法預見早段直紅，裁判 Oliver 出牌少的判斷大致成立。
16363910.headline: 熱刺領先一球，下半場還有 45 分鐘多打一人，大機會控制局面再添進球；水晶宮只能靠反擊或定位球。
16363910.changes: 主勝由 57% 升至 88%，原因是領先一球加上對手十人，和局及客勝大幅下降。最可能比分由 1-0 改為 2-0。熱刺全場角球由 6.6 升至 11.0，水晶宮由 3.8 降至 1.5，因為十人隊伍難以壓上。水晶宮犯規由 11.0 升至 13.0，因為少一人要多阻截；熱刺犯規由 12.5 降至 9.5，因為控球多、少需要犯規。水晶宮黃牌由 2.1 降至 1.6，因為上半場 0 黃，而且少一人後落後方多數收斂；熱刺黃牌維持 1.6。大 2.5 球機率為 39%，兩隊皆進球只有 21%。
16363910.verdict_en: Mateta's VAR-upgraded red card in the 13th minute left Palace with ten men; Spurs dominated and deserve their 1-0 half-time lead.
points_en: The half-time score call was wrong: we predicted 0-0. Mateta's early dismissal was the main reason. Spurs then had 78% possession and A. Gray scored in the 25th minute. Spurs' expected 0.75 first-half goals was close to the actual 1; Palace's expected 0.35 compares with 0 goals and only 0.04 xG.

Corners went the right way but the count was too low: we predicted 3.0 vs 1.7 and the actual was 6 vs 0. The pre-match view that Spurs would have more of the ball and win the corner count was right, and the red card widened the gap. This matches the known bias of underestimating corners when one side dominates.

Fouls and cards: fouls were predicted at 6.0 vs 5.6 and came in at 5 vs 7, roughly accurate, with ten-man Palace fouling to stop attacks. Cards: Spurs 1 yellow (A. Gray), Palace 0 yellows and 1 red. The model could not foresee an early straight red; the read that referee Oliver shows few cards mostly held.
16363910.headline_en: Spurs lead by one with 45 minutes left against ten men and should control the game and likely add more; Palace can only hope for counter-attacks or set pieces.
16363910.changes_en: Home win rises from 57% to 88% because of the one-goal lead against ten men; draw and away win drop sharply. Most likely score changes from 1-0 to 2-0. Spurs full-time corners rise from 6.6 to 11.0 and Palace's fall from 3.8 to 1.5, as a ten-man side struggles to push forward. Palace fouls rise from 11.0 to 13.0 because a man down they must stop more attacks; Spurs fouls fall from 12.5 to 9.5 because they have most of the ball and need to foul less. Palace yellows fall from 2.1 to 1.6 because they had no yellows in the first half and a side down to ten men usually plays more carefully; Spurs yellows stay at 1.6. Over 2.5 goals is 39% and both teams to score only 21%.

16363911.verdict: Arsenal 控球 67% 但進攻效率很低，xG 只有 0.34，和 Hull City 差不多，半場 0-0，賽前預測的 1-0 沒有實現。
points: 進球：賽前預測上半場 Arsenal 進 1.1 球，實際 xG 只有 0.34，越位 4 次，說明 Hull City 的 5-3-2 防線站位成功；43' Havertz 的點球被 VAR 否決，這是 Arsenal 最接近進球的一次
角球方向判斷錯了：預測 3.6 比 1.6，實際 1 比 3。Arsenal 傳中和遠射少，Hull City 打反擊反而拿到更多角球，Saka 缺陣後右路衝擊力下降，可能是原因之一
犯規和黃牌基本準確：Hull City 犯規 7 次、Coyle 34' 吃到黃牌，和預測的「犯規、黃牌集中在客隊」一致；Arsenal 只犯規 2 次，比預測的 4 次少
16363911.headline: 下半場 Arsenal 會加強邊路和替補換人，Hull City 體能下降後防線可能出現空檔，但如果 Arsenal 遲遲不能進球，平局的機率不低。
16363911.changes: 主勝從 80.5% 降到 56%，因為只剩 45 分鐘，而且 Arsenal 上半場製造機會的質量很低；最可能比分從 2-0 改成 1-0，0-0 升到第二位；全場角球從 7.4 比 3.1 改成 5.0 比 4.0，因為上半場角球反而是 Hull City 較多；Arsenal 犯規數下調，Hull City 黃牌維持偏高（已有 1 張，被壓制的時候還會犯規）。
16363911.verdict_en: Arsenal had 67% possession but only 0.34 xG, about the same as Hull City, so it was 0-0 at half-time and the predicted 1-0 did not happen.
points_en: Goals: we predicted Arsenal would score 1.1 in the first half, but their xG was only 0.34 and they were caught offside 4 times, so Hull City's 5-3-2 line worked. Arsenal's closest chance was Havertz's penalty claim on 43', which VAR turned down

We got the corners the wrong way round: predicted 3.6 v 1.6, actual 1 v 3. Arsenal put in few crosses and long shots, while Hull City won more corners on the counter. Losing Saka's threat on the right may be part of the reason

Fouls and cards were about right: Hull City made 7 fouls and Coyle was booked on 34', matching the call that fouls and cards would come mostly from the away side. Arsenal made only 2 fouls, fewer than the 4 we predicted
16363911.headline_en: In the second half Arsenal will push harder down the wings and use their subs, and gaps may open as Hull City tire. If Arsenal can't score for a long time, a draw is quite possible.
16363911.changes_en: Home win cut from 80.5% to 56%: only 45 minutes are left and Arsenal made poor chances in the first half. Most likely score changed from 2-0 to 1-0, with 0-0 now second. Full-time corners changed from 7.4 v 3.1 to 5.0 v 4.0 because Hull City won more corners in the first half. Arsenal fouls lowered. Hull City cards stay high: they already have 1 booking and will keep fouling while under pressure.

16363912.verdict: Brighton 靠早段進球和 Brentford 第 23 分鐘的紅牌完全控制上半場，賽前「半場 0-0」的判斷錯了。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0 錯誤：Brighton 第 15 分鐘就由 D. Gómez 進球，第 42 分鐘 P. Groß 再罰進點球；上半進球預測 0.7 對 0.4，實際 2 對 0，低估了 Brighton 的主場火力。
賽前以為 Michael Oliver 給牌少，上半場卻已有 3 張黃牌，加上 I. Thiago 經 VAR 改判紅牌，牌數預測明顯偏低；犯規 6 對 4，大致接近預測。
角球 3 對 1，和預測的 2.3 對 2.0 方向一致；少一人後 Brentford 控球只有 26%、沒有射正，xG 1.46 對 0.39，Brighton 完全壓制。
16363912.headline: Brentford 少一人又落後兩球，下半場 Brighton 大概率繼續圍攻，再進一球的機會很高；Brentford 只能靠反擊碰運氣。
16363912.changes: 主勝由 47% 升到 93%，首選比分由 1-1 改為 3-0：領先兩球再加上多一人，形勢已經一邊倒。Brighton 角球大幅上調（5.4→7.5），Brentford 下調（4.3→2.5）；Brentford 少一人防守，犯規略降；黃牌因上半場已經累積較多而上調。
16363912.verdict_en: Brighton took total control through an early goal and Brentford's 23rd-minute red card; the pre-match 0-0 half-time call was wrong.
points_en: The 0-0 HT call was wrong: D. Gómez scored on 15' and P. Groß converted a penalty on 42'. We expected 0.7 v 0.4 first-half goals; the actual was 2 v 0, so Brighton's home firepower was underestimated.
We expected Michael Oliver to show few cards, but there were already 3 yellows plus I. Thiago's VAR-upgraded red, so the card forecast was clearly too low. Fouls (6 v 4) were roughly as expected.
Corners went 3 v 1, in line with the 2.3 v 2.0 forecast. Down to ten men, Brentford had 26% possession and no shots on target (xG 1.46 v 0.39).
16363912.headline_en: Two goals down with ten men, Brentford face a second-half siege. Another Brighton goal looks very likely; Brentford's hope is counter-attacks.
16363912.changes_en: Home win raised from 47% to 93% and the top score changed from 1-1 to 3-0, since a two-goal lead plus an extra man makes this one-sided. Brighton corners raised sharply (5.4→7.5) and Brentford's cut (4.3→2.5). Brentford fouls are slightly lower with ten men defending. Yellow cards are higher because of the first-half count.

16363913.verdict: Liverpool 上半場稍佔上風，Mac Allister 第 40 分鐘進球，整體走勢和賽前判斷相符，只是半場比分不是 0-0。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0 錯誤，實際 0-1；上半進球預測 0.4 對 0.7，結果 0 對 1，方向正確。Liverpool xG 1.74 對 0.94，領先合理。
角球 2 對 5，比預測的 1.5 對 2.9 更偏向 Liverpool；犯規 5 對 8，Liverpool 比預測的 6.6 多，壓迫時犯規較多。
黃牌 0 對 1（R. Araújo），基本貼近預測的 0.3 對 0.6；Crystal Palace 有 10 次射門、4 次射正，比預期更有威脅。
16363913.headline: Crystal Palace 下半場會壓上找扳平，Liverpool 有反擊擴大比分的空間，但也要提防 Palace 的射門數。
16363913.changes: 客勝由 60% 升到 74%，首選比分由 0-2 改為 0-1。Palace 落後需要壓上，所以主隊角球上調（3.2→5.0），Liverpool 角球也因上半場已有 5 個而上調（6.8→7.5）；Liverpool 犯規偏多，全場上調到 14；黃牌略降，因為上半場牌數不多。
16363913.verdict_en: Liverpool edged the first half and Mac Allister scored on 40'. The flow matched the pre-match view, but the half-time score was not 0-0.
points_en: The 0-0 HT call was wrong (actual 0-1). We forecast 0.4 v 0.7 first-half goals; the actual 0 v 1 had the direction right. Liverpool's xG of 1.74 v 0.94 justifies the lead.
Corners went 2 v 5, tilted further toward Liverpool than the 1.5 v 2.9 forecast. Liverpool committed 8 fouls, more than the 6.6 expected, partly from pressing.
Cards (0 v 1, R. Araújo) were close to the 0.3 v 0.6 forecast. Crystal Palace had 10 shots (4 on target), more threat than expected.
16363913.headline_en: Crystal Palace will push for an equaliser, which leaves Liverpool space to counter and extend the lead. Palace's shot volume is still a risk.
16363913.changes_en: Away win raised from 60% to 74% and the top score changed from 0-2 to 0-1. Palace must chase, so home corners go up (3.2→5.0); Liverpool's also rise (6.8→7.5) after 5 in the first half. Liverpool fouls raised to 14. Yellow cards slightly lower given the quiet first half.

16363914.verdict: 半場 0-0 和預測一致，但場面比預期平均：Coventry 的 xG 和射門都比 Everton 多，Everton 的主場優勢沒有體現出來。
points: 半場比分 0-0 猜中；預測上半場合計約 1.0 球（Everton 0.7、Coventry 0.3），實際兩隊都沒有進球。下毛毛雨、雙方進攻效率偏低，進球數下調的方向是對的。
攻勢方向和預期相反：Coventry 射門 8 次對 4 次，xG 0.64 對 0.28，還有全場唯一一次絕佳機會。Everton 控球 52% 卻只有 1 腳射正，預測高估了主隊上半場的威脅。
角球 1-1，比預測的 2.6/2.2 少很多；犯規 5-4，Everton 比預期多，Coventry 比預期少；兩隊都沒有黃牌，低於預測的 0.5/0.8，裁判 Attwell 上半場吹得比較寬鬆。
16363914.headline: 下半場只剩 45 分鐘，0-0 的基礎上 Everton 仍略占優勢，但 Coventry 表現不弱；第一個進球很可能決定勝負，平局機率最高。
16363914.changes: 主勝從 56% 降到 35%，平局從 25% 升到 39%，客勝從 19% 升到 26%：已經 0-0 過了半場，比賽時間縮短一半，而且 Coventry 上半場的機會品質比 Everton 好。最可能比分改為 0-0、1-0、1-1（賽前是 1-0、2-0、1-1）。全場角球從 5.3/4.2 下調到 4.0/3.6，因為上半場只有 1-1。全場犯規 Everton 從 9.5 升到 10.5，Coventry 從 12.5 降到 10.0。黃牌因上半場沒有出牌而下調，但 Attwell 本季出牌偏多，下半場比賽變緊後仍可能出牌。
16363914.verdict_en: 0-0 at half-time as predicted, but the game was more even than expected: Coventry had more xG and more shots, and Everton's home edge didn't show.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score was correct. We expected about 1.0 first-half goals (Everton 0.7, Coventry 0.3) and neither side scored. Light rain and blunt attacking made the lower goals call look right.

The run of play went the other way: Coventry had 8 shots to 4, 0.64 xG to 0.28 and the only big chance. Everton had 52% of the ball but just 1 shot on target, so we overrated the home side's first-half threat.

Corners were 1-1, well under the predicted 2.6/2.2. Fouls were 5-4, with Everton above our number and Coventry below it. There were no cards against our 0.5/0.8, as Attwell let play go on in the first half.
16363914.headline_en: With 45 minutes left at 0-0, Everton still have a slight edge, but Coventry have looked good. The first goal will probably decide it, and a draw is the single most likely result.
16363914.changes_en: Home win cut from 56% to 35%, draw up from 25% to 39%, away win up from 19% to 26%: the game is goalless at the break, only half the time is left, and Coventry created the better chances. Most likely scores are now 0-0, 1-0, 1-1 (before kickoff: 1-0, 2-0, 1-1). Full-time corners lowered from 5.3/4.2 to 4.0/3.6 after a 1-1 first half. Fouls moved to Everton 10.5 (from 9.5) and Coventry 10.0 (from 12.5). Cards lowered after a card-free first half, but Attwell shows a lot of cards this season, so more are likely if the second half gets tight.

16363915.verdict: 半場 0-0 和賽前預測一致；Fulham 控球較多，但 Newcastle 的機會質量更高（xG 0.53 比 0.3）。
points: 半場比分 0-0 預測正確，但過程不同：預測 Fulham 上半場進球較多（0.65 比 0.4），實際是 Newcastle 的 big chance 和 xG 都更多，Fulham 雖然控球 62%，射門的威脅卻不大
角球總數接近預測（實際 5 個，預測 5.0），但 Newcastle 3 比 2 略多，賽前「角球向主隊傾斜」的判斷暫時不成立
犯規 3 比 6，總數比預測的 11 少；裁判 Robert Jones 上半場沒有出示黃牌，和他給牌少的習慣一致，預測的 1.3 張黃牌偏高
16363915.headline: 下半場雙方都可能進球：Fulham 繼續控球，Newcastle 打反擊威脅更大，換人和體能會決定勝負，平局的機率最高。
16363915.changes: 主勝從 47% 降到 34%，平局從 26% 升到 38%，客勝大致不變；最可能比分從 1-1 改成 0-0，因為只剩 45 分鐘，而且 Fulham 機會質量不高；全場角球從 6.5 比 4.2 改成 5.5 比 5.5；全場犯規和黃牌都下調，依據是上半場節奏偏慢，裁判給牌也少。
16363915.verdict_en: Half-time 0-0 matched our prediction. Fulham had more of the ball, but Newcastle made the better chances (xG 0.53 v 0.3).
points_en: We got the 0-0 half-time score right, but the game went differently: we expected Fulham to score more in the first half (0.65 v 0.4), yet Newcastle had more big chances and higher xG. Fulham had 62% possession but their shots were not dangerous
Total corners were close to the prediction (5 actual v 5.0 predicted), but Newcastle led 3-2, so our call that corners would favour the home side hasn't held so far
Fouls were 3 v 6, a lower total than predicted. Referee Robert Jones showed no yellow cards in the first half, in line with his habit of giving few cards, so our 1.3 predicted cards were too high
16363915.headline_en: Either side could score in the second half: Fulham will keep the ball while Newcastle look more dangerous on the counter. Subs and fitness will decide it, and a draw is the most likely result.
16363915.changes_en: Home win cut from 47% to 34%, draw up from 26% to 38%, away win about the same. Most likely score changed from 1-1 to 0-0 because only 45 minutes are left and Fulham's chances were poor. Full-time corners changed from 6.5 v 4.2 to 5.5 v 5.5. Full-time fouls and cards both lowered because the first half was slow and the referee gave few cards.

16363916.verdict: Bournemouth 第5分鐘就由 Evanilson 進球，之後全面壓制 Ipswich，賽前預測的半場0-0不對，但看好客隊的方向對了。
points: 半場比分預測0-0，實際0-1：Evanilson 第5分鐘早早進球，打亂了「低進球、零進球機率不低」的節奏；上半場 xG 0.1對1.33，Bournemouth 有2次絕佳機會，Ipswich 一次都沒有，控球56%只是無效控球
角球預測1.5對2.5，實際0對4：Bournemouth 進攻更有威脅，Ipswich 的控球打不進禁區，連一個角球都沒有，正好是「一方佔優時角球被低估」的偏差
犯規預測5.2對5.5，實際1對8，黃牌1對2：犯規集中在 Bournemouth 一方，領先後他們用犯規打斷 Ipswich 的推進；第43分鐘 Tavernier、Enciso、A. Smith 接連吃黃牌，黃牌比預測多
16363916.headline: Ipswich 下半場一定會壓上，角球會增加，但上半場幾乎沒有威脅；Bournemouth 可以打反擊，只是三天前剛踢完歐霸，體能是最大的變數。
16363916.changes: 客勝從50%提高到69%，平局從25%降到22.5%，主勝從25%降到8.5%，因為客隊已經領先，而且上半場 xG 1.33對0.1，客隊明顯佔上風；最可能比分仍是0-1，1-1排第二；全場角球從3.3對5.0改成3.5對6.0（Bournemouth 上半場已有4個，Ipswich 落後要追，下半場角球會多一點）；犯規從11.0對11.3改成6.0對13.0（Ipswich 上半場只犯規1次，Bournemouth 領先後頻繁戰術犯規）；黃牌從2.0對2.7改成2.0對3.2，Bournemouth 已有兩人吃黃牌，下半場會收斂一些。以上只供參考。
16363916.verdict_en: Evanilson's 5th-minute goal put Bournemouth ahead and they controlled the half; the 0-0 half-time call was wrong, but backing the away side was right.
points_en: Predicted HT 0-0, actual 0-1: the early goal broke the expected low-scoring pattern; first-half xG 0.1 vs 1.33, Bournemouth had 2 big chances and Ipswich none, so Ipswich's 56% possession led nowhere
Corners predicted 1.5 vs 2.5, actual 0 vs 4: Bournemouth carried the real threat and Ipswich's possession never got into the box, the known under-estimate of corners when one side dominates

Fouls predicted 5.2 vs 5.5, actual 1 vs 8; cards 1 vs 2: Bournemouth fouled to break up Ipswich's build-up after scoring, and three yellows came around 43' (Tavernier, Enciso, A. Smith), more cards than expected
16363916.headline_en: Ipswich must push forward in the second half, so expect more corners for them, but they created almost nothing before the break; Bournemouth can counter, though fatigue from the Europa League game three days ago is the main risk.
16363916.changes_en: Away win raised from 50% to 69%, draw cut from 25% to 22.5%, home win from 25% to 8.5%, because Bournemouth already lead and won the first-half xG 1.33 to 0.1. 0-1 stays the most likely score, with 1-1 second. FT corners go from 3.3 vs 5.0 to 3.5 vs 6.0 (Bournemouth already have 4; a trailing Ipswich will win a few more). Fouls go from 11.0 vs 11.3 to 6.0 vs 13.0 (Ipswich committed only 1 foul in the first half, while Bournemouth keep fouling tactically to protect the lead). Cards go from 2.0 vs 2.7 to 2.0 vs 3.2; Bournemouth's two booked players should be more careful. Reference only.

16363917.verdict: 上半場 0-0 和賽前預測的半場比分一致。兩隊合計 xG 只有 0.41，各射正 1-2 次，是一場謹慎的低節奏比賽。Tottenham 控球佔優，但沒有製造出明顯威脅。
points: 半場比分 0-0 和上半進球（預測各 0.5）都準確。Leeds 失去 Stach 後中場推進乏力，Tottenham 控球 58% 也只有 0.22 xG，兩隊都沒有打出有效進攻。
角球 1-2，比預測的 1.8/2.6 略少，比賽節奏比預期慢。犯規 6-9，Tottenham 比預測的 6.4 多，主要是限制 Leeds 反擊的戰術犯規。
黃牌 1-1，略高於預測的 0.6/0.8，符合 John Brooks 嚴格執法的風格；van de Ven 已有黃牌，下半場要收斂。43 分鐘 Tottenham 因傷換人，下半場的陣容和換人調度會受影響。
16363917.headline: 下半場兩隊的進攻都不夠鋒利，一個進球很可能就決定比賽。Tottenham 控球較多，略佔上風，但平局仍是最可能的結果。
16363917.changes: 平局從 29% 升到 40%，主勝從 31% 降到 27%，客勝從 40% 降到 33%。原因是半場 0-0、xG 很低，只剩 45 分鐘，0-0 成為最可能的比分。大 2.5 球大幅下降到 14%，雙方都進球降到 22%。全場角球下調到 3.6/5.0（上半場只有 3 個角球）。Tottenham 犯規上調到 15.0，黃牌大致維持在 2.3/2.4。另外 Tottenham 上半場有球員因傷離場，模型看不出這名球員的具體影響，所以只作定性參考。
16363917.verdict_en: 0-0 at half-time, matching the pre-match half-time call. Combined xG was only 0.41 and each side had just 1-2 shots on target. It has been a cautious, low-tempo game: Tottenham have more of the ball but have created little.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score and first-half goals (0.5 each predicted) were right. Without Stach, Leeds struggled to move the ball through midfield, and Tottenham's 58% possession produced only 0.22 xG.
Corners were 1-2, a little below the 1.8/2.6 forecast because the tempo was slow. Fouls were 6-9: Tottenham committed more than the 6.4 expected, mostly tactical fouls to stop Leeds counter-attacks.

Yellow cards were 1-1, slightly above the 0.6/0.8 forecast, in line with John Brooks' strict refereeing. van de Ven is on a booking and needs to be careful. Tottenham made an injury substitution in the 43rd minute, which will affect their line-up and changes in the second half.
16363917.headline_en: Neither attack looks sharp, so one goal will probably decide the game. Tottenham have more control and a slight edge, but a draw is still the most likely result.
16363917.changes_en: Draw raised from 29% to 40%; home win lowered from 31% to 27% and away win from 40% to 33%. With 0-0 at half-time, very low xG and only 45 minutes left, 0-0 is now the most likely score. Over 2.5 goals cut sharply to 14% and both teams to score to 22%. Full-time corners lowered to 3.6/5.0 (only 3 corners in the first half). Tottenham fouls raised to 15.0; yellow cards kept at roughly 2.3/2.4. Tottenham lost a player to injury in the first half, but the model cannot see the effect of one player, so this is only a rough, non-numeric factor.

16363918.verdict: 上半場我們完全沒料到會這麼激烈：預測 0-0，實際打成 2-2。Aston Villa 開場 4 分鐘就領先兩球，Man United 靠點球和 44 分鐘那一球追平。
points: 進球錯得最多：預測半場 0-0、上半場兩隊合計約 1.0 球，結果打了 4 球。Aston Villa 第 1、第 4 分鐘先由 Alysson 進球、再由 N. Jackson 進球。開場這麼早落後兩球，Man United 只能全力壓上，整場節奏一開始就被打亂。Bruno Fernandes 第 16 分鐘點球，第 44 分鐘那一球數據記在 Man United 名下，射手寫的是 Tielemans（他是 Aston Villa 球員，可能是烏龍球）。
整體壓制方向判斷對了：Man United 射門 12 比 6，xG 1.69 比 1.21，角球 4 比 1，比預測的 2.6 比 1.9 更一邊倒。Aston Villa 領先後退守反擊，6 腳射門就拿到 2 球，把握機會的效率很高。
犯規和黃牌偏差較大：預測犯規 5.4 比 5.8，實際 7 比 2。Aston Villa 退守時幾乎不犯規，Man United 追分時犯規較多。目前事件裡沒有黃牌，裁判 Kavanagh 上半場比他平時寬鬆。
16363918.headline: 下半場從 2-2 重新開始。Man United 在主場、而且射門和 xG 都佔上風，取勝機會稍大，但兩隊防守都不穩，平局機率很高。
16363918.changes: 全場勝平負從 45/27/28 改為 39/37/24：剩下 45 分鐘、比分持平，所以平局機率明顯上升；Man United 場面佔優，因此主勝仍略高於客勝。最可能比分從 1-1 改為 2-2。大 2.5 球和雙方都進球已經確定，都是 100%。全場角球主隊上調到 7.6（上半場已有 4 個，壓制明顯），客隊下調到 3.8。全場犯規主隊上調到 12.6，客隊大幅下調到 8.4（Aston Villa 上半場只犯規 2 次）。黃牌目前是 0，但 Kavanagh 一向出牌偏多，下半場比賽也可能更緊張，所以全場黃牌下調到每隊約 1.8 至 1.9 張，不再按賽前約 2.8 張的水平。以上僅供參考。
16363918.verdict_en: We badly misread the first half: we predicted 0-0 and it finished 2-2. Aston Villa scored twice inside 4 minutes, and Man United came back with a penalty and a goal in the 44th minute.
points_en: Goals were the biggest miss: we expected a 0-0 half with about 1.0 goal in total, and there were 4. Alysson (1') and N. Jackson (4') scored very early for Aston Villa, which forced Man United to push forward from the start. Bruno Fernandes scored a penalty (16'). The 44' goal is credited to Man United with Tielemans listed as the scorer; he plays for Aston Villa, so it was likely an own goal.

We got the direction of control right: Man United led shots 12-6, xG 1.69-1.21 and corners 4-1, which is even more one-sided than our 2.6-1.9 corner forecast. Aston Villa sat back after going ahead and scored 2 goals from only 6 shots, a very efficient return.

Fouls and cards were off: we predicted 5.4-5.8 fouls and the real count was 7-2. Aston Villa hardly fouled while defending, and Man United fouled more while chasing. No cards appear in the events so far, so referee Kavanagh has been more lenient than his usual standard.
16363918.headline_en: The second half restarts at 2-2. Man United are at home and ahead on shots and xG, so they have a slightly better chance of winning, but both defences look shaky and a draw is very possible.
16363918.changes_en: Full-time win/draw/loss moved from 45/27/28 to 39/37/24: with 45 minutes left and the score level, the draw is much more likely, and Man United's edge in play keeps the home win slightly ahead of an away win. Most likely score changed from 1-1 to 2-2. Over 2.5 goals and both teams to score are already settled at 100%. Home corners raised to 7.6 (they already have 4 and are clearly on top), away corners lowered to 3.8. Home fouls raised to 12.6; away fouls cut sharply to 8.4 (Aston Villa committed only 2 in the first half). Cards are still at 0, but Kavanagh usually gives plenty and the second half may get tenser, so full-time yellows are cut to about 1.8 to 1.9 per side instead of the pre-match level of about 2.8. For reference only.

16363919.verdict: Nott'm Forest 在第 6 分鐘和第 18 分鐘兩次進球，以 25% 控球率取得 2-0 領先；賽前預測的半場 0-0 和 Man City 熱門判斷都錯了。
points: 半場比分和進球都沒預測對：賽前判斷 Nott'm Forest 主場進球乏力，上半場預計進球只有 0.4 個，結果 Jair（6'）和 L. Delap（18'）早早進球。7 次射門有 4 次射正，雙方 xG 只有 0.83 和 0.91，說明主隊把握機會的效率遠高於平時，比分領先程度大於實際機會差距。
Man City 控球 75%，但 xG 只有 0.91、射正 3 次，控球沒有轉化成足夠的威脅；早段兩個失球後，Nott'm Forest 退守反擊，Man City 打得很被動。上半場角球預測 1.9 比 2.7，實際 2 比 4，方向正確，Man City 這邊略低估了。
犯規預測偏高：預測 7.0 比 4.8，實際只有 4 比 3，符合裁判 Barrott 尺度寬鬆的特點，不過主隊犯規的數字估得太高；上半場雙方都沒有黃牌，與預測的 0.4 比 0.3 大致相符。
16363919.headline: 下半場 Man City 會全力壓上，角球和射門會更一邊倒；Nott'm Forest 會退守、拖延時間，靠反擊尋找第三球，Man City 至少扳回一球的機會不小。
16363919.changes: 賽前預測 Man City 客勝 54%、首選比分 0-1，現在改為 Nott'm Forest 勝 76.5%、首選比分 2-1，原因是主隊已經兩球領先，Man City 下半場需要進兩球才能追平。全場角球從 4.2 比 5.6 改為 3.5 比 8.0，因為落後的 Man City 會長時間圍攻。全場犯規從 14.5 比 10.0 下調到 10.5 比 8.0，因為上半場只有 7 次犯規，裁判尺度寬鬆，但主隊退守後犯規次數會增加。黃牌從 2.1 比 1.6 小幅下調到 1.7 比 1.2，下半場主隊拖延時間和戰術犯規可能吃牌。大 2.5 球升到 80.8%，因為只要再進一球就成立。
16363919.verdict_en: Nott'm Forest scored early through Jair (6') and L. Delap (18') to lead 2-0 at half-time with only 25% possession; the pre-match calls of 0-0 at the break and Man City as favourites were wrong.
points_en: Half-time score and goals were missed: the model expected only 0.4 first-half goals from a Forest side that had not scored at home, but Jair and Delap scored early. Forest put 4 of 7 shots on target while the xG was only 0.83 vs 0.91, so their finishing was far more clinical than the chances suggest.

Man City had 75% of the ball but only 0.91 xG and 3 shots on target, and possession did not turn into real threat. After the early goals Forest sat deep and countered. First-half corners were predicted at 1.9 vs 2.7 and came in at 2 vs 4, so the direction was right but City's total was a little low.

Fouls were overestimated: 7.0 vs 4.8 predicted, 4 vs 3 actual. That fits Barrott's lenient refereeing, though Forest's fouls were set too high. No first-half bookings, roughly in line with the 0.4 vs 0.3 forecast.
16363919.headline_en: Expect Man City to push hard after the break, with corners and shots even more one-sided. Forest will sit deep, waste time and look for a third on the counter. City have a good chance of pulling at least one goal back.
16363919.changes_en: Before kick-off we had a 54% City win and 0-1 as the top score. Now it is a 76.5% Forest win with 2-1 as the top score, because Forest lead by two and City need two goals just to draw. Full-time corners go from 4.2 vs 5.6 to 3.5 vs 8.0, as City will lay siege. Fouls drop from 14.5 vs 10.0 to 10.5 vs 8.0: only 7 were called in the first half under a lenient referee, though Forest will foul more while defending deep. Cards trimmed from 2.1 vs 1.6 to 1.7 vs 1.2, with Forest likely booked for time-wasting and tactical fouls. Over 2.5 rises to 80.8% because one more goal settles it.

16363920.verdict: Chelsea 控球 68% 卻幾乎沒有威脅，Sunderland 靠 Le Fée 的點球領先，賽前看好 Chelsea 的方向錯了。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0 錯誤，實際 1-0；Sunderland xG 1.71 對 0.19、3 次絕佳機會，Chelsea 控球雖多卻打不開局面，和缺 J. Pedro 等主力相符。
Sunderland 第 4 分鐘就因傷換人，但並未影響反擊；角球只有 0 對 1，遠低於預測的 2.3 對 2.5。
犯規 7 對 1，Sunderland 遠多於預測（5.3），Chelsea 遠少（5.9）；黃牌 1 對 1，接近預測。
16363920.headline: Chelsea 下半場必須加強進攻、增加傳中，Sunderland 會更深地防守並打反擊；Jarred Gillett 執法，下半場牌數可能增加。
16363920.changes: 由客勝 44% 改為主勝 65%，首選比分由 1-1 改為 1-0：Sunderland 領先，而且上半場機會質量遠高於對手。上半場角球極少，所以兩隊全場角球都下調（4.6→2.0、5.4→5.0）；Sunderland 犯規上調到 13，Chelsea 下調到 6.5。
16363920.verdict_en: Chelsea had 68% possession but almost no threat, and Sunderland lead through Le Fée's penalty. The pre-match lean toward Chelsea was wrong.
points_en: The 0-0 HT call was wrong (actual 1-0). Sunderland had xG 1.71 v 0.19 and 3 big chances; Chelsea's possession went nowhere, consistent with missing J. Pedro and others.
Sunderland made an injury substitution on 4' without losing their counter-attacking threat. Corners were only 0 v 1, far below the 2.3 v 2.5 forecast.
Fouls went 7 v 1: Sunderland well above the 5.3 forecast, Chelsea far below 5.9. Cards (1 v 1) were close to the forecast.
16363920.headline_en: Chelsea must step up their attack and cross more; Sunderland will sit deeper and counter. With Jarred Gillett refereeing, more cards are likely after the break.
16363920.changes_en: Changed from a 44% away win to a 65% home win and the top score from 1-1 to 1-0, since Sunderland lead and created far better chances. Both teams' corners cut (4.6→2.0, 5.4→5.0) after a near-empty first half. Sunderland fouls raised to 13, Chelsea's lowered to 6.5.

rules.zh: 1X2 以腳本基準為底，再向賽季模型靠攏：沒有具體新資訊（主力傷停、確定陣容、賠率大幅變動）時，AI 對任何結果的調整不超過 ±8 個百分點。賽季模型（model）和市場基準相差超過 5 點時，取兩者的中間值，不要直接採用市場。熱門勝率的上限：主場熱門 60%，客場熱門 55%；只有在 xG 預期明顯佔優、對手有多名主力缺陣時才可以超過。熱門 3 天內要踢歐冠，或者近期連續輸球、射門效率低迷時，再減 3–5 點，加到平局。
rules.en: Anchor 1X2 on the scripted baseline and lean toward the season-only model: with no concrete new info (key absences, confirmed XI, big odds moves) adjust any outcome by at most ±8 pts. If the season model and the market baseline differ by >5 pts, use their midpoint rather than the market. Cap favourites at 60% at home and 55% away unless they have a clear expected-xG edge and the opponent has several key absences. If the favourite plays a UCL game within 3 days, or is on a losing run with poor shot conversion, take another 3–5 pts off and add them to the draw.
rules.evidence: 30 場累積 Brier：model 0.574 優於 AI 0.620、基準 0.627、市場 0.629、收盤 0.638（三輪都是 model 最好）。≥54% 的熱門 8 場只中 2 場（Tottenham 60% 2-0、Liverpool 56% 4-0）；落空的有 Man City 65%（1-1）、Brighton 59%（0-2）、Arsenal 57%（2-2）、Man City 55%/54%、Chelsea 44%。有歐冠分心的 Aston Villa 0-0、Arsenal 2-2

rules.zh: 客隊是控球型熱門，而主隊打防守反擊、高強度逼搶或主場表現穩定時，客勝不可高於去水後的市場機率，主勝至少比市場高 3 點，平局不低於 27%。客隊有 ≥3 名主力缺陣或換門將時，再從客勝移 5–8 點到主勝或平局。控球率高不等於能控制比賽，判斷要看預期射門和 xG。
rules.en: When the away side is a possession favourite and the home side counters, presses hard or has a solid home record: away win no higher than the de-vigged market, home win at least 3 pts above market, draw at least 27%. If the away side has ≥3 key absences or a keeper change, move another 5–8 pts from the away win to the home win or draw. Possession is not control; judge by expected shots and xG.
rules.evidence: 6 場：Leeds 1-0 Tottenham（控球 39%）、Nott'm Forest 3-1 Man City（控球 22%）、Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea（Chelsea 控球 69%，xG 0.53）、第 11 輪 Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal（Arsenal 控球 66%，平局）、Hull City 2-0 Brighton（Brighton 控球 70%，給了 59%）、第 9 輪 Newcastle–Everton

rules.zh: 平局下限：任何比賽的平局機率都不低於 23%；兩隊實力接近而且總 λ<2.5 時，不低於 28–30%。熱門是控球型、但近期進攻效率差（射正率低、xG/射門低）時，平局不低於 25%。比分前三選項必須至少包含一個平局比分（1-1 或 0-0）。
rules.en: Draw floor: never below 23% in any match; 28–30% when the teams are evenly matched and total λ<2.5. If the favourite dominates possession but is converting poorly (low shots on target, low xG per shot), keep the draw at 25% or more. The top-3 scorelines must include at least one draw (1-1 or 0-0).
rules.evidence: 平局被低估的 6 場：Man City 1-1 Fulham（平局只給 19%，前三選項沒有平局）、Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland（24%）、Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal、Aston Villa–Fulham 1-1（26%）、Hull City–Ipswich 2-2、Fulham–Newcastle 1-1

rules.zh: 總進球以基準和市場進球線為準（30 場累積 bias −0.03，不必全面調整）。兩隊後防都有主力缺陣，或者其中一隊場均失球 ≥2.2，或者強隊主力全部首發對上弱防守時，總進球加 0.3–0.5，雙方進球機率加 5–8 點。比分選項要覆蓋分布的兩端：主隊被看好、客隊進攻弱時要有 1-0 或 2-0；預期進球 ≥2.7 時要有一個 3 球以上的比分（3-1、2-2、3-2）。
rules.en: Use the baseline and market goal line for total goals (30-game bias −0.03, so no blanket shift). Add 0.3–0.5 goals and 5–8 pts to BTTS when both defences miss key players, either side concedes ≥2.2 per game, or a strong side's full first XI faces a weak defence. Scorelines should cover both tails: include 1-0 or 2-0 when the home side is favoured against a weak attack, and one 3+ goal score (3-1, 2-2, 3-2) when expected goals are ≥2.7.
rules.evidence: 總進球 bias −0.03（30 場）。進球偏多被低估的 5 場：Coventry 3-2 Crystal Palace（Palace 10 場失 24 球、Coventry 缺主力後衛）、Bournemouth 2-0 Nott'm Forest（xG 合計 5.0）、Man United 4-4 Aston Villa、Crystal Palace 1-3 Liverpool、Chelsea 1-4 Leeds。另外 30 場中約 10 場是 1-0 或 2-0（包括 Tottenham 2-0 Ipswich）

rules.zh: 半場更新：0-0 時，平局機率最多只比賽前高 10 點，熱門勝率最多砍 15 點，因為下半場常常會打開，而且補時還會進球。只領先一球、xG 差距 <0.5 時，領先方勝率上限約 60%，平局至少 25%。早段紅牌，或強弱分明的比賽已經兩球領先時，可以大幅上調領先方（勝率 >90%，比分選項要有再多進 1–2 球的結果）。
rules.en: Half-time update: at 0-0, raise the draw by no more than 10 pts over pre-match and cut the favourite by no more than 15 pts, since second halves often open up and stoppage-time goals happen. With a one-goal lead and an xG gap <0.5, cap the leader at about 60% and keep the draw at 25% or more. After an early red card, or a two-goal lead in a mismatch, push the leader hard (>90%, scorelines with 1–2 more goals).
rules.evidence: 0-0 或一球領先的 6 場：Everton–Coventry 3-1、Leeds–Tottenham（79' 進球）、Chelsea–Man United 2-0、Hull City–Ipswich 2-2、Aston Villa–Fulham 1-1、Hull City 2-0 Brighton（半場 0-0，90' 後進兩球）。大幅上調做對的 2 場：Liverpool–Man United（98%，4-0）、Brentford–Everton（半場更新為 3-0，結果 4-0）

rules.zh: 黃牌：全場以基準加約 0.2 張，上半場減約 0.1 張，增加的部分集中在 75 分鐘以後。裁判場均數據最多調 ±0.5 張。不要自動把黃牌偏向弱隊或控球少的一方：控球型熱門久攻不下、靠反搶壓制時，黃牌按兩隊平均分；少一人或落後 ≥2 球的一方，黃牌減約 1 張。開場 30 分鐘已經 ≥2 球的比賽，全場黃牌下調約 1 張。
rules.en: Yellow cards: about +0.2 on the full-time baseline and −0.1 in the 1st half, with the extra cards mostly after 75'. Referee averages shift the total by at most ±0.5. Don't automatically give more cards to the underdog or the low-possession side: if a possession favourite counter-presses and can't score, split cards evenly. A side down to ten or trailing by ≥2 gets about 1 fewer card. If there are ≥2 goals in the first 30 minutes, cut total cards by about 1.
rules.evidence: 上次調整後，30 場累積 bias 上半場 +0.10、全場 −0.09，已接近零，所以把調整幅度縮小。熱門反而吃較多牌的 3 場：Tottenham 4 對 Ipswich 1、Brighton 4 黃 1 紅對 Hull City、Arsenal 3（預測 2.0）。落後或少一人的一方牌少 2 場：Man United 0 張（預測 2.6）、Everton 1 張（預測 1.9）。裁判數據不準：Attwell→2、Kavanagh→2、Oliver→6

rules.zh: 犯規：全場比基準加約 0.6 次；上半場照基準，不再下調。主隊用高強度逼搶對付控球型客隊時，主隊犯規加 3–5 次；控球型熱門久攻不下時，自己的犯規也不要壓低。不要預設控球少的一方犯規較多：退守的弱隊可能很少犯規。少一人或落後 ≥2 球的一方犯規減 2–3 次；一方大比分領先又控球時，雙方總犯規減約 3 次。
rules.en: Fouls: add about 0.6 to the full-time baseline; use the 1st-half baseline unchanged (no more cut). A home side pressing hard against a possession-based visitor gets +3–5 fouls; don't lower a frustrated possession favourite's fouls either. Don't assume the low-possession side fouls more: a deep-sitting underdog may foul little. A side down to ten or trailing by ≥2 gets −2–3 fouls; when one side leads comfortably and keeps the ball, cut total fouls by about 3.
rules.evidence: 30 場累積全場犯規 bias −0.65，上半場 −0.07（上次的下調已修正）。逼搶型主隊被低估的 2 場：Newcastle 19 對 Arsenal 7（預測 13.8/10.4）、Sunderland 20 次（預測 13.2）。「控球少的一方犯規多」的假設失敗 3 場：Hull City 7 對 Brighton 17、Liverpool 15 對 Man United 8、Tottenham 17 對 Ipswich 17。一面倒時犯規少：Brentford–Everton 8 對 9

rules.zh: 角球：壓制程度要用預期射門和 xG 判斷，不要用控球率。強隊 xG 預期明顯佔優，或者早段落後追分時，這一方角球比基準加 1.5–2，弱隊減 1。控球型熱門很難把球傳進禁區（近期角球少、xG 低）時，不要因為控球多就多給角球。打反擊或定位球的一方角球不要壓到 3 個以下。勢均力敵又節奏慢時，總角球減 1.5–2。
rules.en: Corners: judge dominance by expected shots and xG, not possession. When the strong side has a clear xG edge or is chasing an early deficit, give it +1.5–2 corners over baseline and the weaker side −1. Don't add corners to a possession favourite that struggles to get into the box (few recent corners, low xG). Don't push a counter-attacking or set-piece side below 3 corners. In even, slow games cut total corners by 1.5–2.
rules.evidence: 壓制時被低估：Aston Villa 7 對 Sunderland 2、Man United（落後）8-1、Man City（落後）7-3、Man City–Brighton 8-2、Tottenham–Crystal Palace 20-0。控球多但角球少：Arsenal（66%）3 個、Brighton（70%）4 個。弱隊不要壓太低：Ipswich 6 個（預測 3）、Fulham 6 個（預測 3.6）。均勢比賽被高估：Fulham–Newcastle 3-3、Everton–Coventry 2-2、Sunderland–Chelsea 2-2

rules.zh: 對手少一人時（半場更新或已知紅牌），強隊在剩餘時間的角球比原預測至少加 3–5 個，對手角球估 ≤2 個；強隊多進一球的機率上調。少一人的一方犯規減約 30%，黃牌最多估 1 張；雙方犯規總數下調。
rules.en: When the opponent is down to ten (half-time update or known red card), add at least 3–5 corners to the strong side for the remaining time and give the opponent ≤2; raise the chance of more goals for the strong side. Cut the ten-man side's fouls by about 30%, give it at most 1 yellow, and lower total fouls.
rules.evidence: 5 場：Liverpool–Man United（8' 紅牌，角球 15-5，Man United 8 次犯規、0 張黃牌，4-0）、Brentford–Everton（40' 紅牌，4-0，犯規 8 對 9）、Tottenham–Crystal Palace（角球 20-0）、Brighton–Brentford（射門 20-5）、Chelsea–Man United

playbook.summary_zh: 這次把「熱門加碼」收得更緊：主場熱門上限 60%、客場 55%，和市場相差大時向賽季模型靠攏，並加入全場平局下限和比分選項要有平局。犯規和黃牌不再預設偏向弱隊或控球少的一方（改看逼搶和少一人等情況），全場犯規上調；黃牌調整幅度縮小；角球改用 xG 判斷壓制，不看控球率。原本「實力接近時的平局下限」併入新的平局守則。
playbook.summary_en: Tightened favourite caps (60% home, 55% away) and blended toward the season-only model when it disagrees with the market; added a draw floor and a draw scoreline in every top 3. Fouls and cards no longer default to the underdog or low-possession side (pressing and red-card context decide), full-time fouls go up, card adjustments are smaller, and corner dominance is judged by xG rather than possession. The old close-match draw rule was merged into the new draw rule.
